articles.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
articles.content: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by $\boldsymbol{300\times}$ ($\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.

articles.title_zh: DreamX:视频传播模式是一个通用的Latent动作学习器
articles.content_zh: 从录像中学习普遍的行动表现需要建立模型,在对同一行动的不同处决中保持一致,但对表现和外表的变化却无动于衷。 现有的潜伏行动模型推断出视觉过渡中的行动,但其表现往往以无关的视觉变异缠绕了内在行动,限制了跨表征的转移. 我们引入了DreamX,它重新将一个经过预先训练的视频传播模型作为通用的潜在动作学习者. 我们的方法从视频模型丰富的spatiotal特性中提取出紧凑的潜在动作,用$\boldsymbol{300\times}$(\boldsymbol{1{,}200\rightarrow 4}$符来压缩每个潜在的视频框。 此外,通过利用视频模型的先基因,这些潜在动作捕捉与视觉外观脱节的动作相关动态. 由此产生的潜在空间充当了跨越(人和机器人)、环境和行动参数化的共同行动界面。 在LARY-Bench上,DreamX在潜在行动模型中实现了最先进的性能. 此外,在一个背景下编码的行动在另一个背景下依然有效:潜在的空间支持任何到任何视频传输和跨越不同表现和环境的零镜头动作传输。 此外,这一共享界面还使政策学习能够在一个紧凑的潜在行动空间中进行,从而降低基于视频传播的政策的计算成本。

articles.title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
articles.content: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.

articles.title_zh: 植被环境可视三维重建基准参考生成软件
articles.content_zh: 对植被丰富的室外环境中的视觉立体重建和深度估计的可靠评价受到以下因素的限制:几何地面真实数据稀缺,扫描仪调查费用也很高。 我们提出一个基于LiDAR的参考生成管道,用于评价向导的视觉几何模型的零射性能,以及常规的结构自动方法。 管道再利用相机图像,LiDAR扫描,以及来自现有多传感器本地化数据集的参考面,生成每个视图深度图和可见参考点云. 为了解决累积的LiDAR扫描中的可见度错误,我们在隐藏点清除(HPR)中引入了用于点向可见度过滤和自动比例选择的大型深度-Gap可见度分数(LDGVS). 对TartanAirV2和TartanGround的实验显示,与Poisson表面重建(一种适合完成扫描调查的方法)相比,HPR和LDGVS综合过滤在可比绝对相对误差时保留了大约三倍的点密度. 我们还将管道应用于BotanicGarden数据集,以系统比较深度估计和立体重建方法。 FeedForward方法能高效地产生密集的深度预测,但其3D重建可以包含重复的结构. 常规SfM一般能产生更连贯的几何特征,但其重建仍然稀少,在挑战性的植被场景中更容易失败. 将发布基准工具包和数据集。

articles.title: GSCV++: Lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression via Standard Video Codecs
articles.content: This paper presents GSCV++, a lightweight pipeline for 3D {G}aussian {S}platting (GS) sequences {C}ompression with standard {V}ideo codecs. To meet the requirements of low-complexity and hardware compatibility from the industry, GSCV++ jointly improves preprocessing, 3D-to-2D mapping, and practical video compression configuration of GS compression. First, for preprocessing, energy-adaptive inter-frame spherical harmonic (SH) alternative current (AC) dimensionality reduction (EA-SHDR) is proposed to produces a compact and stable temporal SH AC feature space. It can reduce the data volume of following mapping and practical compression, as well as less complexity while eliminating redundant information. Second, for 3D-to-2D mapping, prior-based Inter-MiniPLAS (P-MiniPLAS) is designed to generate smooth 2D feature maps through prior-based weighting factor inference and small scale remapping. Compared with vanilla Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and Morton scan, P-MiniPLAS ensures the generated 2D maps are more suitable for the video codec while maintaining a low level of computational complexity. Third, for practical compression, content-aware generalized compression (CA-GC) is developed to use a non-uniform bit-depth split for coordinate map generation, and a coding unit size selection is introduced for efficient compression complexity control, which fully exploits the performance of video codecs without involving normative changes. Experiments demonstrate that GSCV++ reports over 20\% in intra- and 60\% in inter-prediction rate-distortion gains compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. GSCV++ also achieves faster 2D map generation, encoding, and decoding than other SOTA methods using the same type of video codecs. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed modules and provide insights for subsequent research.

articles.title_zh: GSCV++:轻量级3D高斯电镀序列通过标准视频编码压缩
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍GSCV++,是3D {G}澳洲 {S}电镀(GS)序列的轻量级管道 {C}用标准的 {V} ideo 编码器进行压缩 。 为了满足行业对低复杂度和硬件兼容性的要求,GSCV++联合改进了预处理,3D对2D映射,以及GS压缩的实用视频压缩配置. 首先,关于预处理,建议采用能适应的球体间谐波(SH)替代电流维度降低法(EA-SHDR),以产生紧凑而稳定的时空SH AC特征空间. 它可以减少后续绘图的数据量和实际压缩,以及减少复杂性,同时消除冗余信息. 其次,对于3D对2D映射,前置的Inter-MiniPLAS(P-MiniPLAS)通过前置的加权因子推论和小尺度重映射来生成平滑的2D特征图. 与香草平行线性分配排序(PLAS)和莫顿扫描相比,P-MiniPLAS确保生成的2D地图更适合视频编码,同时保持较低的计算复杂性. 三,为实际压缩,开发内容意识通用压缩(CA-GC),采用非统一比特深度分割方式进行坐标映射生成,并引入编码单位大小选择,用于高效压缩复杂度控制,充分发挥视频编码器的性能而不涉及规范修改. 实验表明,GSCV++在预测内和60++中报告与最新技术方法相比的预测率扭曲收益超过20++。 GSCV++还比其他使用同类型视频编码器的SOTA方法实现更快的2D地图生成,编码,解码. 研究核实拟议单元的有效性和稳健性,并为随后的研究提供见解。

articles.title: OpenBrain: An Auditable Generated-Label Release for Whole-Brain MRI Parcellation
articles.content: Automatic tools can now generate whole-brain MRI parcellations at cohort scale, but generated-label releases often provide little evidence about which cases are reliable enough to reuse. We introduce OpenBrain, a confidence-aware release of 35,838 provenance-verified OpenNeuro T1w cases from 607 source datasets. OpenBrain is organized as an auditable case-record release rather than a directory of standalone segmentation files: each record links a primary parcellation, two committee parcellations, source/license provenance, raw QC-7 measurements, percentile risks, a combined risk score R, and a confidence tier. QC-7 is a reference-free reliability panel over label geometry, image-label consistency, and committee disagreement, so users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold generated labels without rerunning inference. We evaluate this released evidence under a frozen protocol. Across external cohorts, lower QC-7 risk corresponds to higher generated-label quality; in fixed-budget training, lower-risk selections improve paired macro Dice over random selection by +3.2 to +3.7 percentage points. OpenBrain also exposes raw axes, committee outputs, provenance, and datasheet documentation, so confidence claims remain inspectable after download. It does not turn generated labels into manual annotations or clinical-grade segmentations. Its contribution is a large open generated-parcellation substrate, a reusable case-level risk-evidence layer, and an external validation protocol for release-time QC. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain. Code: https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain.

articles.title_zh: OpenBrain: 用于全脑磁共振解析的可审计生成-标签发布
articles.content_zh: 自动工具现在可以生成组分规模的全脑磁共振分解,但生成的标签释放往往不会提供多少证据,说明哪些案例是可靠的,足以重复使用. 我们引进了OpenBrain,从607个源数据集中释放出35,838个来源验证的OpenNeuro T1w病例的自信. OpenBrain被组织为可审计的个案记录发布,而不是独立的分区文件目录:每个记录链接一个主块,两个委员会块,源/许可证来源,原始QC-7测量,百分位风险,一个综合风险分数R,以及一个信任级. QC-7是一个在标签几何,图像标签一致性,和委员会分歧之上的无参考可靠性面板,因此用户可以过滤,加权,审核,或重置生成的标签而不重置推论. 我们根据冻结协议评估了释放的证据 在整个外部组群中,较低的QC-7风险对应更高的生成标签质量;在固定预算培训中,低风险选择改进配对宏 以+3.2至+3.7个百分点的分数比随机选择多. OpenBrain还揭露了原始轴,委员会输出,出处,以及数据表文档,因此信任主张在下载后仍然可以检查. 它不会将生成的标签转化为人工说明或临床级分解. 它的贡献是一个大型的开放生成-隔离基质,一个可重复使用的案例级风险-证据层,以及释放时间QC的外部验证协议. 数据集:https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-11. 代码:https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain. 中国植物物种信息数据库.

articles.title: Wonder 4: A Mixture-of-Experts Recipe for Image Quality Enhancement
articles.content: A real photograph is often blurry, grainy, compressed, scratched, and low-resolution at the same time. Each defect has its own severity and its own place in the image. The corrections for these defects conflict with each other. Exist- ing models describe the whole image with one description, so they cannot say where each correction belongs. To solve this problem, we present Wonder 4, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model for image quality enhancement. It corrects several defects of a real photograph at the same time, each in the region where it occurs. Every block of the model holds a mixture of N = 13 experts. A router, trained with the model, sends every image patch to k = 5 of them. No degradation classifier, mask, prompt, detector, or task label is used. Another issue is that standard MoE training, taken from language models, pushes every expert toward equal use. Equal use applies every correction everywhere, even where it is not needed. We replace this rule with a bias that only sets a minimum share of use. Across all patches, an expert used less than this minimum gets higher router scores until it is selected again. An expert above the minimum is not changed, so no expert is forced to be used as often as the others. The bias needs no extra loss. The method adds no extra module and no extra processing step. We evaluate Wonder 4 on DIV2K and Flickr2K, against five published methods and three open-weight pipelines. It reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS, and NIQE on all three test settings (DIV2K x4, DIV2K x8, and Flickr2K x4).

articles.title_zh: Wonder 4: 增强图像质量的混合专家配方
articles.content_zh: 真实的照片往往模糊,粒状,压缩,刮伤,同时分辨率低. 每一个缺陷在图像中都有其自身的严重程度和位置. 对这些缺陷的纠正相互冲突。 Exist-ing模型用一个描述来描述整个图像,所以它们不能说每个修正属于哪里. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了Wonder 4,一种增强图像质量的专家混合模型。 它同时纠正了真实照片的若干缺陷,每一照片发生在照片发生的地区。 该模型的每个区块都持有N=13位专家的混合物. 用模型训练的路由器将每个图像补丁发送到 k = 5 其中. 不使用降解分解器、遮罩、即时器、探测器或任务标签。 另一个问题是,从语言模型中抽取的教育部标准培训将每个专家推向平等使用。 平等使用适用于所有地方的纠正,即使不需要。 我们用一种只规定最低使用份额的偏见来取代这一规则。 在所有补丁中,使用少于此最小值的专家可以获得更高的路由器分数,直到再次被选中. 超过最低限的专家不改变,因此没有专家被迫像其他人一样经常被使用. 偏见不需要额外损失。 该方法没有添加额外的模块,也没有额外的处理步骤. 我们用DIV2K和Flickr2K来评价Wonder 4, 它在所有三个测试设置上都达到了最好的LPIPS,DISTS,和NIQE(DIV2K x4,DIV2K x8和Flick2K x4).

articles.title: Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification
articles.content: 3D point cloud classification, a task in computer vision, has recently gained substantial interest due to its extensive applications across various domains such as augmented and virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, classifying 3D point clouds becomes challenging in real-world scenarios where the density levels vary. These variations are due to limitations inherent to current sensing technologies and variable environmental conditions, which often prevent the capture of detailed and comprehensive geometric representations. Existing classification methods, which have demonstrated impressive results on dense point clouds, may be affected and could experience reduced performance when dealing with low-density point clouds. Addressing this challenge, this paper introduces LD-PointNet++, an architecture optimized for the classification of low-density point clouds. To pave the way for LD-PointNet++, we conduct the first benchmarking study that systematically evaluates state-of-the-art point cloud classification methods across varying densities, revealing significant performance declines in low-density environments. Experimental results on the ModelNet benchmark dataset demonstrate that LD-PointNet++ not only outperforms these methods in low-density scenarios but also demonstrates consistent accuracy above 90% across different density levels.

articles.title_zh: 低敏度 3D 点云分类
articles.content_zh: 3D点云分类是计算机视觉中的一项任务,由于它广泛应用于各种领域,例如增强和虚拟现实、机器人和自主驾驶,最近引起了很大的兴趣。 然而,在密度水平不同的现实世界情景中,3D点云的分类变得具有挑战性. 这些变化是由于目前的感知技术和可变环境条件所固有的局限性,这些条件往往阻碍获取详细而全面的几何表示. 现有的分类方法在密度点云上取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但在处理低密度点云时可能会受到影响,并且可能出现性能下降. 为应对这一挑战,本文引入了LD-PointNet++,一种为低密度点云分类而优化的架构. 为了为LD-PointNet++铺平道路,我们进行了第一次基准研究,系统地评价不同密度的最先进的点云分类方法,揭示低密度环境中的绩效显著下降。 模型Net基准数据集的实验结果表明,LD-PointNet++不仅在低密度假设中超过了这些方法,而且显示不同密度水平的一致准确度超过90%。

articles.title: Anchored Rank-Adversarial Fine-Tuning Pretrained Visual Place Recognition Models
articles.content: Visual place recognition (VPR) localises a camera by retrieving similar geo-tagged images, and current foundation-model VPR models are accurate across cities, seasons and illumination, but not robust to adversarial perturbations: under a white-box attack on the ranking at an imperceptible budget of 1/255, SuperVLAD and BoQ keep at most 0.2% top-1 recall (R@1) on four benchmarks. We propose anchored rank-adversarial fine-tuning (ARAFT), which fine-tunes a released model with a listwise rank loss on each adversarial query's hardest positive and an anchor to the clean descriptor of the frozen pretrained model. Checkpoints are selected under a clean-accuracy budget fixed in advance, and the full trade-off is reported. Within five validation R@1 points of clean cost, plain adversarial training has no admissible checkpoint, whereas ARAFT raises robust R@1 from zero to 47.3 on SuperVLAD and 55.3 on BoQ; plain adversarial training exceeds this only at about three times the clean cost. Against unbudgeted plain adversarial training on the test sets, ARAFT matches its robust R@1 at 2/255 with about ten more clean R@1 points. At 4/255, plain adversarial training is 6-9 robust R@1 points ahead, while ARAFT still keeps its ten-point clean advantage. Developed on SuperVLAD, ARAFT transfers to BoQ without re-tuning, and its robustness holds against stronger optimisers, with no sign of gradient masking.

articles.title_zh: 悬赏级 Fine-Tuning 预训视觉场所识别模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉位置识别(VPR)通过检索相似的地理标记图像来本地化一个相机,而目前的基础模型VPR模型在城市,季节和光线上是准确的,但坚固到对抗性的扰动:在以1/255的不可见的预算对排名进行白盒攻击下,SuperVLAD和BoQ在四个基准上最多保持了0.2%的最高1回(R@1). 我们提出固定的等级对抗微调(ARAFT), 检查点按照事先确定的清真预算选择,并报告全部取舍. 在5个确认点的R@1清洁成本范围内,普通对抗训练没有可允许的检查站,而ARAFT则在SuperVLAD和BoQ上将坚固的R@1从0提高到47.3;普通对抗训练仅以清洁成本的大约3倍就超过了这一点。 ARAFT在2 255 点时, 在4/255时,平庸的对抗训练领先6-9强R@1分,而ARAFT仍然保持其10分的干净优势. 在SuperVLAD上开发,ARAFT在不重新调整的情况下向BOQ转移,其坚固性与更强的选手相比,没有梯度遮挡的迹象.

articles.title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
articles.content: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns. Consequently, they provide limited supervision and evaluation for multimodal stateful interaction, which requires models to understand, maintain, update, and faithfully realize evolving dialogue states across turns. To address this gap, we introduce YANAMI, the first large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, comprising YANAMI-400K and YANAMI-Bench. YANAMI-400K contains 400K multi-turn multimodal dialogues, with more than 2M images and 2.6M dialogue turns. The dialogues span four representative scenarios: Multi-Image Fusion, Image Editing, World Modeling, and Visual Reasoning, and require models to continuously track, preserve, and revise evolving multimodal dialogue states across turns. YANAMI-Bench comprises 400 multi-turn dialogues for systematically evaluating multimodal stateful interaction. It jointly evaluates Dialogue State Understanding and Visual Realization, characterizing the gap between models' ability to understand evolving dialogue states and their ability to faithfully realize them in visual outputs. Experiments show that fine-tuning BAGEL on YANAMI-400K improves image editing, generation, and multimodal stateful interaction by 10.3%, 2.0%, and 13.23%, respectively, while preserving its general visual understanding capabilities. Evaluations on YANAMI-Bench further reveal that existing UMMs still struggle to maintain, update, and visually realize evolving multimodal dialogue states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: YANAI: 大型多式联运数据集和多国互动基准
articles.content_zh: 统一多式联运模式将视觉理解、生成和编辑整合在一个统一框架内。 然而,现有的统一的多式联运数据集和基准仍然以单回合任务为主。 即使在最近的多回合数据集中,许多回合也可以独立解决,而无需跟踪跨回合的信息. 因此,它们为多式联运状态互动提供了有限的监督和评价,这需要模型理解、维持、更新和忠实地实现不断变化的跨周期对话国。 为了弥补这一差距,我们介绍了YANAI,这是第一个大型多式联运对话数据集和状态互动基准,包括YANAI-400K和YANAI-Bench。 YANAI-400K包含400K的多回合多式对话,有超过2M图像和2.6M对话回合. 对话涉及四个具有代表性的情景:多图像融合、图像编辑、世界建模和视觉理性,并需要模型不断跟踪、保存和修订不断变化的跨周期多式联运对话状态。 YANAI-Bench由400个多回合对话组成,用于系统评估多模式状态互动。 它联合评价“对话国家理解和视觉实现”,说明模型理解不断发展的对话国家的能力与其在视觉产出中忠实实现这些能力之间的差距。 实验显示,对YANAI-400K上的BAGEL进行微调,将图像编辑、生成和多模式状态互动分别提高10.3%,2.0%和13.23%,同时保持其一般视觉理解能力。 对YANAMI-Bench的评价进一步表明,现有的UMM在维持、更新和视觉上实现不断发展的多式联运对话状态方面仍有困难。

articles.title: Möbius: A Unified Motion-Language Model Bridging Understanding and Generation
articles.content: We aim to build a truly unified motion model that can understand, generate, and edit human motion within a single framework. Existing motion UMMs remain only partially unified: motion understanding is handled by a language model, while generation is often delegated to a separate diffusion module operating over learned motion latents. We introduce Möbius, which brings the entire diffusion process into the same multimodal representation space used for motion understanding. Clean motion, noisy motion, and text jointly participate in shared attention, while role-specific parameters process understanding and generation streams. Importantly, Möbius operates directly on continuous frame-level raw motion, requiring neither discrete tokenization nor a pretrained motion VAE. This simple formulation naturally supports motion captioning, text-to-motion generation, temporal completion, and instruction-guided editing within a single model. On HumanML3D, Möbius achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified motion models. Scaling to 1.7B parameters and 1,700 hours of motion data further demonstrates that our framework is both effective and scalable.

articles.title_zh: Möbius: 统一运动语言模型,构建理解和生成
articles.content_zh: 我们的目标是建立一个真正统一的运动模式,能够在单一的框架内理解、产生和编辑人类的运动。 现有的运动UMM仍然只有部分统一:运动理解是由语言模型处理的,而生成常常被下放到一个单独的扩散模块,运行在学习的运动潜伏上. 我们介绍Möbius,它把整个传播过程带入同一个用于理解运动的多式联运代表空间。 干净的运动,吵闹的运动,和文字共同参与共同关注,而特定角色的参数会过程理解和生成流. 重要的是,Möbius直接运行在连续的帧级生动运动上,既不需要离散的标注,也不需要预先训练的运动VAE. 这种简单的配方自然支持在一个单一模型内进行运动标题,文字到动作生成,时间完成,以及指令引导编辑. 在HumanML3D上,Möbius在统一运动模型中实现了最先进的性能. 放大到1.7B参数和1 700小时的运动数据进一步表明,我们的框架既有效又可扩展。

articles.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
articles.content: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任何路线:通用AI系统模式和政策路线研究
articles.content_zh: 人工一般智能(AGI)需要一种能够理解,生成,理性,并跨不同领域和模式行动的方法. 现在实现AGI的一条有希望的道路不是依靠单一的模式来掌握每一种能力,而是将各种专门模式、工具和政策(候选人)的多样化生态系统编成一个统一的AI系统。 这一愿景的核心是一个根本问题:AI系统如何在平衡业绩和计算成本的同时,动态地选择和协调每项任务中最有能力的候选人? 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Route Anything,这是研究跨通用AI系统的模型和政策路径的统一框架. 我们发展一个统一的理论基础,在质量成本权衡下确定最佳路线,并确定路由器可用信息如何决定其可实现的性能。 为了系统地调查各种能力的路径,我们首先构建了一个全方位模式轨迹矩阵,跨越25个基准,跨越语言理解、图像、视频和语音生成、编码和工作场所代理以及机器人操纵,其中374 401分来自452个候选配置。 在这个框架的基础上,我们训练和测试不同的路由器,以调查全方位模式路由的潜力,学到的路由器的能力,以及路由提高效率的条件. 我们的结果显示了能力协调的巨大机会:每输入甲骨文的路由比最佳固定候选人高出5.4分,学到的路由器在16个基准中比它高出0.3分,在视频生成上比2.1分,在机器人操纵上比1.1分,同时利用了24%的政策时间。 更重要的是,与参考模型相比,路由平均提高了8.82x的效率.

articles.title: Diagnosis by Composition: Detecting and Localizing Unseen Diseases by Composing Learned Radiological Findings
articles.content: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.

articles.title_zh: 按组成情况进行诊断:通过得出辐射调查结果发现不明病并查明其位置
articles.content_zh: 辐射诊断的深层模型一般都经过培训,可以直接从图像中预测疾病标签,从而将其限制在培训期间看到的疾病,使其决定难以用放射学家的术语解释. 然而,放射学通过公布的准则从视觉发现变为疾病,这些准则使这一决定具有明确性、可解释性和可复制性。 我们引入了通过组成(DbC)进行诊断的方法,这是一种代表学习框架,它编码了这一结论-第一逻辑。 DbC通过将图像特征与发现的文本嵌入相配合来学习放射性发现的词汇,每个发现在扫描上以密集的地图表示. 一种疾病由一套从它的准则中得出的必要结果来定义,其诊断图是对应的发现图的固定的,无参数的构成. 由于发现到病症的映射来源于准则而非学识,DbC通过设计可以解释和审计,可以通过不进行再培训而具体说明其发现,从而延伸至新疾病,并通过编集其发现来诊断看不见的疾病. 在多相肝CT中,DbC检测和定位隐形疾病,来自不同机构的罕见疾病,外部群比所有参照物强得多,包括将图像与疾病名称相匹配的模型. DbC还改进了在完全监督下的环境下的检测和本地化,在培训设置规模上仍然优越。 虽然在肝脏CT上得到证明,但DbC适用于放射性准则通过发现对疾病作出定义的地方。

articles.title: PLANTEUR: A Crop-Type Segmentation Benchmark for Tropical Regions
articles.content: We introduce PLANTEUR, a benchmark for crop-type mapping from satellite images in the French overseas territories. Building on the PASTIS design, PLANTEUR provides georeferenced and aligned Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 sequences with parcel-derived labels spanning six tropical regions and an 8-class label space. We define both a standard test split and a leave-one-island-out protocol to measure cross-territory generalization, and evaluate fully supervised models, linear probes, and fine-tuned foundation models. The benchmark code and data are open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PLANTEUR:热带区域作物分类基准
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了PANTEUR,这是从法国海外领土卫星图像中绘制作物类型的地图的基准。 在PASTIS设计的基础上,PLANTEUR提供了地理参照和对齐的Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1和Landsat-8序列,并附有覆盖六个热带区域的包裹标签和一个8级标签空间。 我们既定义了标准测试分解,又定义了离岛协议,以衡量跨领土的概括,并评价了完全监督的模型,线性探测器,以及微调的基础模型. 基准代码和数据是开源的,可在GitHub和Hugging Face上查阅.

articles.title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
articles.content: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

articles.title_zh: 自我监督的插件前传 超声波视频修复
articles.content_zh: \ textit{目标 :} 超声波视频受到硬件受限的空间分辨率和信号依赖光谱的限制,而成对的低分辨率和高分辨率收购则很少可供监督修复. 我们的目标是联合超解析和解析超声波视频,而不配对培训数据或网络再培训。 \ textit{方法 :} 我们提出UltraDiff,它使用一个冷冻的预训练扩散模型(DM)作为前置插件,并通过在测距限制最大范围内的后置配方下优化DM采样器的潜在种子来恢复每个帧. 我们从Rayleigh比例-家庭模型中得出了一个光谱-认识数据-真实性术语,并描述其相对剩余和差异-适应性加权特性。 我们进一步引入一种稳定的忠诚度,其界限在下方,在对数强度上严格对流,以进行未显示形式的正观测。 一种总变异调节器补充了DM前作,一个时间种子更新从前作的优化种子开始每个帧的温暖启动. \ textit{ 结果 :} EchoNet-LVH带模拟光谱和添加剂噪音的视频上,具有自然影像前传的UltraDiff将PSNR改进1.24\,dB比最强基线,超声波前传进一步改善. 在真实的临床回声心电图视频上,UltraDiff将零射弹射分数(EF)预测的平均绝对误差从7.31分降至6.37分,相对于最强基线DUP. \ textit{结束语 :} 将Speekle-aware忠贞与冻结的传播前科结合起来,就能够进行无地面真实的超声波视频修复,有利于下游的测量。 \ textit{ 标志 :} UltraDiff既不需要对数据进行配对,也不需要再培训,而且不与特定的传播检查站挂钩。 与这项工作有关的守则将在接受后公布。

articles.title: TAQ-MOTR: Tracking-Aware Detection Query Formation for End-to-End Multiple Object Tracking
articles.content: Tracking-by-propagation (TBP) methods perform end-to-end multi-object tracking by propagating track queries across frames, jointly handling detection and identity association without heuristic post-processing while naturally modeling temporal information. However, as detection and association are tightly coupled, detection queries in TBP are expected to discover currently untracked objects and provide complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracks whose queries and identities are retained. Existing methods largely inherit detection-query formation from single-frame detection and construct such queries before the decoder with little awareness of trajectory states. Consequently, currently untracked objects may be missed, while challenging tracked objects with reduced visibility under occlusion may lack complementary evidence, causing association failures or duplicate responses. To address these issues, we propose TAQ-MOTR, a tracking-aware detection query formation framework that employs a pre-decoder Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) to fuse current-frame image features, track memory, and learnable memory. By conditioning detection queries on trajectory states, TAQ-MOTR adapts them to \rev{the discovery of currently untracked objects and tracked-object complementation We further introduce a training-only auxiliary detection branch whose one-to-one label assignment is decoupled from that of the main tracking branch, providing additional detection supervision to strengthen the shared HQG and decoder for the discovery of currently untracked objects. TAQ-MOTR improves performance on DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and BFT, achieving 72.0 HOTA, 63.1 AssA, and 76.6 IDF1 on the DanceTrack test set. Code is available at https://github.com/Magicmiya/TAQ-MOTR

articles.title_zh: TAQ-MOTR: 跟踪-智能检测 跟踪多对象跟踪的查询
articles.content_zh: 逐项传播(TBP)方法通过跨帧传播轨迹查询来进行端到端的多对象追踪,在不进行热处理后联合处理检测和身份关联,同时自然模拟时间信息. 然而,由于检测和关联紧密结合,预计TBP中的检测询问将发现目前没有跟踪的物体,并为保留询问和身份的质疑轨道提供补充性当前框架证据。 现有方法在很大程度上继承了单帧探测器的探测-静脉形成,并在解码器前构造这种查询,对轨迹状态知之甚少. 因此,目前没有跟踪的物体可能会被错过,而在隐蔽下对能见度降低的跟踪物体提出质疑可能缺乏补充证据,造成关联失败或重复答复。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用TAQ-MOTR(跟踪-知觉检测查询形成框架),采用预解码混合查询生成器(HQG),将当前帧图像特性、跟踪内存和可学习的内存融为一体。 TAQ-MOTR通过在轨迹状态上调节检测查询,使其适应\rev{发现目前未跟踪的物体和跟踪对象互补 我们进一步引入了只培训的辅助检测分支,其一对一的标签分配与主跟踪分支的标签分配脱钩,提供额外的检测监督,以加强共享的HQG和解码器,用于发现目前没有跟踪的物体. TAQ-MOTR改进了DanceTrack,SportsMOT和BFT的性能,实现了72.0 HOTA,63.1 AssA,以及76.6 IDF1的DanceTrack测试集. 代码见https://github.com/Magicmiya/TAQ-MOTR。

articles.title: Robust Reconstruction of Power Lines from Incomplete Mobile and Aerial LiDAR Data
articles.content: Accurate vegetation-encroachment assessment and risk mitigation require electric utilities to accurately locate and characterize distribution-network assets, including poles and power lines, and distinguish among medium-voltage, low-voltage, neutral, and telecommunication lines. Mobile and aerial Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) point clouds provide detailed 3D representations of these assets and their surroundings. However, power-line detection and reconstruction remain challenging because conductor returns are often sparse, incomplete, noisy, or occluded by vegetation. These challenges are especially significant in distribution networks, where lower pole heights and complex line configurations place conductors close to trees. In addition, mobile and aerial LiDAR datasets differ substantially in point density, viewing geometry, spatial coverage, and occlusion patterns. We propose a robust and automated reconstruction method combining scaled density-based clustering, robust polynomial fitting, and iterative fragment merging to recover individual conductors under severe data incompleteness and occlusion. Following semantic classification, the same reconstruction pipeline processes both mobile and aerial LiDAR data without modality-specific code or parameter tuning. The method is evaluated through degradation experiments, benchmarking, parameter sensitivity analysis, and large-scale validation. On the aerial dataset, it achieves 96.87% precision, 96.66% recall, a 96.76% F$_1$-score, and a geometric RMSE of 0.127 m. On the mobile dataset, where conductor-level reference annotations were unavailable, it achieves a point-to-model RMSE of 0.045 m and a reconstruction coverage of 95.27%. Source code, documentation, and evaluation data are publicly available at https://github.com/varen-project.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从不完全移动和空中LiDAR上大力重建电力线路 数据
articles.content_zh: 准确的植被疏解评估和风险缓解要求电力公用设施准确定位和定性分布网资产,包括电杆和电线,区分中压,低压,中性,电信线路. 移动和航空光探测和测距(LiDAR)点云提供了这些资产及其周围的详细3D表示. 然而,电力线的探测和重建仍然具有挑战性,因为导电器的返回往往很少、不完整、吵闹或被植被占据。 这些挑战在分销网络中尤其显著,在网络中,下极高度和复杂的线路配置将导体放置在树附近. 此外,移动和航空LiDAR数据集在点密度、观测几何、空间覆盖和隐蔽模式方面差异很大。 我们提出一种强力和自动化的重建方法,结合以密度为单位的集成、强力的多元装配和迭代片段合并,以便在严重数据不全和闭塞的情况下恢复单个导体。 在语义分类之后,同样的重建管道会同时处理移动和航空的LiDAR数据,而不进行模式特定代码或参数调试. 该方法通过降解实验,基准,参数灵敏度分析,以及大规模验证等方法进行评估. 在航空数据集上,它实现了96.87%的精确度,96.66%的回溯率,96.76%的F$_1美元分数,以及0.127米的几何RMSE. 在没有导电级参考说明的移动数据集上,实现了点对点RMSE0.045米,重建覆盖率95.27%. 来源代码、文件和评价数据可在https://github.com/varen-project上公开查阅。

articles.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
articles.content: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 参数化 MLLM 混合图像检索嵌入
articles.content_zh: 编成的图像检索(CIR)旨在获取一个给定的参考图像和修改文本的目标图像. 虽然最近利用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的办法已显示出重大的进展,但我们争辩说,MLLM的构成理解仍然没有得到充分利用。 这源于直接将所构成的查询映射成仅通过对比性监督而嵌入的检索,而没有明确解决预期的视觉修改。 在这项工作中,我们引入了因果化的 MLLM 嵌入(FactEmbed),它将构象查询理解与构建歧视性嵌入脱钩. FactEmbed不直接将所构成的查询投射成一个没有内部推理的单一嵌入,而是使用一套因子化的潜伏物,通过中间目标想象目标模拟预期的视觉修改. 这一过程鼓励潜伏者在形成供检索的歧视性表述之前,进入目标语义。 随后,为了在整个模型中传播这些因子化的表示,我们优化了因子级的对比性损失,同时将分解的表示分解成MLLM更深的注意力层. 最后,为了有效推论,我们保留了一种[EOS]标志,以便在这些因素化的潜质之上建立一个全球层次的嵌入物,同时我们利用平均集合的因素化潜质,以可忽略不计的代价重新排列一个简短的候选名单,因为两者都是通过同样的前进通道产生的。 广泛的评价表明,FactEbed在以往工作上超越了CIR基准。

articles.title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
articles.content: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

articles.title_zh: 从自然图像到医疗扫描:医疗图像生成传播模型的可转移性
articles.content_zh: 从自然图像中进行转录学习是受监督的标准,在自我监督的医疗图像分析中越来越多地采用,但其在基因建模中的作用,特别是扩散阴茎的作用,仍然没有得到充分发挥. 医学传播模型一般从零开始训练登革热者,没有系统评价自然图像的传导. 我们通过潜在和像素范式,模型大小(131M-952M)和两个放射学数据集(RadIMageNet,BrATS)来分析这一点,并询问传输支持生成的哪些方面. 我们发现: (一)自然图像初始化持续改善生成,在像素空间的相对gFID为21-34%,而在潜在空间的相对gFID为14%,在潜在空间中,标致器提供了大部分前作. gFID增益反映下游病理分类和放射特征FD,两者都是临床忠贞的代名词. (二) 效益反映空间结构,而不是语义学:语义学的检验不能预测生成质量,而一个适应内部凹陷者表示轨道的空间结构度量标准为0.85美元,将空间组织定位为预先训练表的渠道。 iii) 混合域的Denoiser训练显示,自然影像和医学影像在晚期街区之间有相似的分层表示,将自然影像混合到医学训练中可以提高忠诚度. (四) 转移补助金与自然图像初始化、超过本地医疗预培训以及若干重新初始化计划挂钩。 总体来说,自然形象的创造者 向医疗的转变是积极的 代码见https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit。

articles.title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.

articles.title_zh: 模特儿看见什么了? 基于LLM的多式联运视频分析中的代表性有效性
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)允许社会科学家对视频进行规模分析,但研究人员必须决定视频的哪些部分作为输入提供. 我们使用表达有效性这一术语来审查文本、音频、视频和综合投入如何影响衡量和随后的分析。 我们比较了6个开放重量的MLLM和3个人类附加说明的视频数据集的输入表示. 没有代表的表现一贯最好。 在7个与新闻有关的构件中,各模型(macro-F1=.70-.77)的本地-视频性能差异不大,而提取的文本性能则从.52到.80不等. 三个模型在文本上表现较好,三个则在视频上表现较好. 综合投入很少能改善业绩。 更准确的分类也无法可靠地得出更接近基于人类代码的估计数。 在42个比较中的17个比较中,最高的F1代表最能复制人类编码的回归系数. 即使每个模型使用其最高的F1可部署代表,45%的样本流行率估计数与人编码基准不同,超过10个百分点。 因此,输入表示法要求验证所测量的构造和由此产生的标签估计的数量。

articles.title: PadLoc: Training-Free Floor-Plan Localization by Sparse Geometric Matching
articles.content: We propose PadLoc, a training-free localization back-end that places a moving sensor within a known floor plan. Floor plans are cheap, persistent, and robust to appearance change, but recent learned-depth methods localize against them by filtering per-frame depth through dense $(x,y,θ)$ pose grids. PadLoc keeps the swappable depth front-end and replaces the dense grid back-end with sparse geometric matching: dominant wall orientations define a small pose-candidate set, masked normalized cross-correlation scores observed free space against the plan, and a moving-pose Gaussian-mixture Bayes filter plus consensus readout decodes the trajectory. Holding each competitor's depth fixed, PadLoc matches or beats UnLoc's forward filter and the F3Loc filter at every Gibson trajectory length, and UnLoc's offline refinement from $T=35$ on; it exceeds Z-FLoc's published results with a shared MapAnything front-end. On Bonn LiLocBench, PadLoc improves pooled SR@1m over UnLoc by 23-32 pp under wheel odometry and 35-43 pp with ground-truth motion; with full-FOV LiDAR plus wheel odometry the same readout reaches 100% SR@1m at 9-10 cm median error on the static sequence. On the Hilti-Trimble Localization Challenge PadLoc localizes a camera-only fisheye rig on construction floors hundreds of metres across at 0.90-0.98 online SR@2m on three of five sessions; adding learned wall isolation, applied to every session, covers all five at 0.67-0.92 with the localizer unchanged throughout. PadLoc thus matches or outperforms dense grid back-ends while preserving sensor modularity and a compact state that does not grow with trajectory length.

articles.title_zh: PadLoc:由Sparse几何技术制作的免费培训地板-规划本地化 匹配
articles.content_zh: 我们提议PadLoc, 一个免费的本地化后端 将移动的传感器置于已知的地板上。 楼层图案价格低廉、持久且强于外观变化,但最近学到的深入方法通过密集的$(x,y,θ)美元布置网格过滤每帧深度,使其适合当地情况。 PadLoc保留了可互换深度前端并用稀疏的几何匹配来取代稠密的网格后端:主壁方向定义了一个小的姿势封装集,遮掩的常态交叉对映得分对照计划观察到自由空间,移动的拥有高斯-密克斯滤波器加上共识读出解码了轨迹. 持有每个竞争者的深度固定,PadLoc匹配或击败UnLoc的前置滤波器和F3Loc的滤波器,每个Gibson轨迹长度,以及UnLoc的离线精度从$T=35美元升起;超过Z-FLoc的公布结果,共享地图Anything的前端. 在Bonne LiLoc Bench上,PadLoc将集合SR@1m在UnLoc之上改进为在轮光度测量下23-32pp,在35-43pp上改进为地面真实运动;在全FOV LiDAR加轮光度测量下,静态序列中位误差达到100%的SR@1m。 在Hilti-Trimble本地化挑战赛上,PadLoc将数百米跨度的建筑层上仅安装一台摄像机鱼眼钻机,每5场中有3场为0.90-0.98的在线SR@2m;在每场比赛中,增加学习的墙壁隔离,每场比赛都适用,所有5场为0.67-0.92,而本地化器全程不变。 PadLoc因此匹配或超过密集网格后端,同时保留传感器模块化和不随轨迹长度增长的紧凑状态.

articles.title: Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
articles.content: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.

articles.title_zh: Perturb, 修理, 校验: 自我弹射视野语言验证器, 用于构成理解
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言核查者判断一个图像是否忠实地与文字描述相符,但现有的培训管道通常依靠更强大的外部法官的静态监督或整理硬阴性数据。 这种监督需要外部生成或注释,由教师负责,而且难以随着模型故障的演变而适应。 我们引入了PROVE(Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Experience),这是一种通过闭塞式扰动-验证-修复-验证循环对验证员进行培训的自演框架. 从已知的正确图像封装对开始,突变器在对象,属性,计数或关系上引入打字扰动. 核查人然后判断扰动的字幕并提供文字反馈,修理人用这些文字反馈来回收一个忠实的字幕进行重新核查. 这两轮核查对信息不匹配和视网膜修理产生结构性奖励。 由于扰动、核查和修理是同一演变中的多式联运主干线的角色条件行为,更新共享参数也改进了核查者本身。 实验表明,PROVE改进了跨模型尺度和家庭的精细成份核查,并加强了参考主干线上的视觉-细节强健性,对更广泛的多式联运任务进行了有限、依赖基准的改变。

articles.title: When Cell Crops Share a Parent: Measuring and Isolating Acquisition Leakage in Cervical Cytology Benchmarks
articles.content: Public cervical cytology benchmarks release many cell crops cut from far fewer microscope fields or slides and are often split at the crop level, so test cells share acquisition parents with training cells. In a preregistered study, crop-level splitting raised SIPaKMeD accuracy by 0.97 percentage points across twelve architectures and twenty seeds (95% CI 0.59-1.39), and CRIC accuracy by 12.08 points (11.16-12.99). On SIPaKMeD, a factorial that fixes training crop and parent counts attributes the gain to sibling exposure (1.73 points, 0.95-2.51), not to the extra parent diversity of crop-level splits (0.00). Parent identity is decodable at about 100 times chance, yet erasing 82% of its above-floor linear recoverability left the gap unchanged, and Grad-CAM did not distinguish leaking from clean models; matching test cells' color statistics to an unseen same-class field removed most of the advantage. Decodability and saliency cannot substitute for a parent-disjoint split.

articles.title_zh: 当细胞作物共享父母:测量和隔离子宫颈细胞学中的获取漏液
articles.content_zh: 公共宫颈细胞学基准释放出许多从远为较少的显微镜场或滑动中切除的细胞作物,并且经常在作物层面被分化,因此测试细胞与训练细胞共享获得父母. 在一项预先登记的研究中,作物一级的分块将SIPAKMED的精度提高了0.97个百分点,涉及12个建筑和20个种子(95% CI 0.59-1.39),审评委的精度提高了12.08个百分点(11.16-12.99)。 在SIPAKMED上,一个修补训练作物和母体计数的因子将收益归结于兄弟接触(1.73分,0.95-2.51分),而不是归结于作物一级分数的额外母体多样性(0. 父母身份的解码率大约是100倍,但消除了82%的上层线性可恢复性,使差距保持不变,Grad-CAM没有区分从清洁模型中漏出;将测试细胞的颜色统计与未见的同级域匹配,消除了大部分优势. 解码性和显著性不能取代父母离异的分裂.

articles.title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
articles.content: High-fidelity photovoltaic (PV) module mapping requires complete instance recovery and accurate delineation. Vision foundation models offer zero-shot segmentation, but converting incomplete and inconsistent predictions across views into a complete, geometrically accurate map of individual modules remains challenging. We propose the Multi-View PV Module Mapper (MV-PVMapper), a training-free framework coupling vision foundation models with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry. First, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) generates candidates from original images using text prompts. Their contours are then transferred into object space through per-module slope correction to limit distortion from surface-model noise, and verified against representative module dimensions to guide cross-view instance selection. Finally, accepted instances return to all covering images as box prompts for SAM~3, supplementing text prompts with spatial cues for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion. On five-direction surveys of three operational rooftop PV plants at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recover 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at an intersection-over-union (IoU) matching threshold of 0.5. Macro-averaged area precision and recall reach 99.00 % and 98.52 %, respectively. Averaged across sites, the aggregated Jaccard index reaches 97.55 %, compared with 60.73 % and 41.24 % for orthomosaic segmentation and multi-view pixel-voting baselines, respectively; average precision at the stricter IoU threshold of 0.95 reaches 95.67 %. Ablation studies show that module-size constraints are critical for instance separation, while slope correction and feedback to all covering views improve boundary accuracy. These results are achieved without task-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates.

articles.title_zh: 从多视图无人驾驶飞行器图像中绘制的无光伏光伏模块的高可靠性培训图
articles.content_zh: 高可靠性光伏(PV)模块绘图需要完整的实例恢复和准确的划界。 远景基础模型提供零射分解,但将不完全和不一致的跨观点预测转换成完整,几何准确的单个模块地图仍然具有挑战性. 我们提议采用多维光电模块映射仪(MV-PVMapper),这是一种无培训框架结合无人驾驶飞行器摄影测量的视觉基础模型。 首先,Sip Anything Model 3(SAM 3)利用文本提示从原始图像中生成候选人. 然后通过每个模块坡度校正将其轮廓转移到物体空间,以限制表面模型噪声的扭曲,并对照代表性模块尺寸进行校验,以指导交叉视图实例选择。 最后,被接受的事例作为SAM~3的框提示返回所有覆盖图像,用空间提示补充文本提示,用于迭代分割、核实和聚变。 在大约1厘米纳迪尔地面采样距离上对三个运行中的屋顶光电厂进行5个方向的勘测时,两次反馈迭代在7 711个参考单元中回收了7 710个,在0.5的交联比值下没有假阳性。 宏观平均面积精确度和召回率分别达到99.00 %和98.52%. 各地的Jaccard总指数平均达到97.55%,而整形分裂和多视像素投票基准分别为60.73%和41.24%;更严格的IoU阈值0.95的平均精度达到95.67%。 校正研究显示,模块大小限制是分离等关键因素,而坡度校正和反馈给所有覆盖观点则提高边界准确性。 这些成果是在没有任务特定图像注释或分区模型重量更新的情况下实现的.

articles.title: Label-Preserving Fourier Domain Adaptation with Generative-AI and Real Style Donors for 3D Mitral Valve Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate segmentation of the mitral valve from three-dimensional transesophageal echocardiography (3D TEE) is severely restricted by the scarcity of publicly available expert- annotated volumetric datasets. To address this critical limitation, we investigated Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA), utilizing general-purpose generative-AI images (from platforms like Chat- GPT, Google Gemini, and Microsoft MAI) as annotation-free style donors for 3D mitral valve segmentation. We employed a DeepMitral residual U-Net model on the public MVSeg2023 dataset, comparing six conditions over three runs: real-only training, traditional augmentation, FDA with each generative source, and a non-AI FDA control using real-image style donors, plus an optimization-matched real-only control and a \b{eta} sensitivity analysis. Case-level paired testing showed that FDA with these generative sources led to significant reductions in boundary- and surface-related errors across all three donor conditions relative to the primary real-only baseline. However, the impact on the core segmentation metric, Generalized Dice Score (GDS), proved generator-dependent. ChatGPT-FDA showed a significant GDS advantage over the optimization-matched control but not over the primary baseline, and Gemini-FDA showed no significant GDS difference. Notably, only MAI-FDA provided a statistically robust and significant increase in GDS compared to the primary baseline. The \b{eta} sensitivity was not robust across training runs. These findings confirm that FDA remains an important augmentation mechanism. While generative-AI images offer a practical means of acquiring style diversity without new annotations, the non-AI control performed comparably to ChatGPT-FDA, so we do not conclude that this approach is superior to training with real-image donors.

articles.title_zh: 与 Generative-AI 和 3D Mitral 阀门分割的真正样式捐助者一起保存 Fourier 域的标签
articles.content_zh: 由于缺乏公开提供的专家注释卷片数据集,从三维横断面式回声心电图(3D TEE)中精确分解的线粒体阀受到严格限制. 为了解决这一关键限制,我们调查了Fourier Domain Reformation(FDA),利用通用基因-AI图像(来自Chat-GPT,Google双子座和Microsoft MAI等平台)作为3D线粒体阀门分割的无注释风格捐赠者. 我们在公共MVSeg2023数据集上采用了DeepMitral残余U-Net模型,将六个条件比作三个运行条件:真实的训练、传统的增强、FDA和每个基因源,以及非AI的FDA控制,使用真实图像风格的捐赠者,加上优化匹配的真实的控制和\b{eta}敏感性分析。 个案一级的对等测试显示,林业发展局与这些基因来源相比,所有三个捐助方条件的边界和地表误差都比主要实际基线大为减少。 然而,对核心分化度量度(通用二分分数)的影响证明取决于发电机。 ChatGPT-FDA显示GDS相对于优化匹配的控制具有显著的优势,但相对于主基线则没有,双子座-FDA显示没有显著的GDS差异. 值得注意的是,只有MAI-FDA提供了与主要基线相比,GDS在统计上强劲和显著的增长。 整个训练环节的敏感性并不强。 这些调查结果证实,林业发展局仍然是一个重要的增强机制。 虽然Generative-AI图像提供了在没有新说明的情况下获得风格多样性的实用手段,但非AI控制比照ChatGPT-FDA进行,因此我们不认为这种方法优于对真实图像捐赠者的培训.

articles.title: Characterizing the vertical continuity of fuel strata based on TLS point clouds Gaussian decomposition and overlap metrics
articles.content: Vertical forest structure influences fire behavior by regulating understory-to-canopy fuel connectivity, yet operational fuel-type models represent this complexity through discrete classes that only indirectly capture vertical continuity. High-density point clouds offer an opportunity to characterize vertical fuel connectivity in a more explicit and continuous manner, but specific methodological approaches are still required. We applied Gaussian decomposition to vertical height profiles derived from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds across 25 permanent forest plots to characterize geometric vertical fuel continuity. A multiscale analysis spanning from the plot scale to ~0.5 $m^2$ units was used to evaluate geometric, probabilistic, and overlap metrics for characterizing fuel strata. The method reproduced the vertical transition between shrub and tree strata, with median Pearson correlations ranging from 0.83 to 0.96 across analysis levels. Probability density overlap metrics and separability indicators, such as the Jeffries-Matusita distance, provided complementary descriptors of vertical continuity. Intermediate spatial scales (3-6 m cells) provided a useful compromise between spatial detail and the consistent representation of shrub-canopy interaction patterns. Finer scales increased variability due to point density reduction and profile irregularity, and low mean squared error values were found insufficient as sole performance indicators. Gaussian decomposition applied to TLS point clouds enables explicit quantification of vertical fuel continuity, a limitation of current discrete classification systems. Continuous vertical connectivity metrics derived from this approach offer a pathway for improving ladder fuel characterization and strengthening decision-making support in wildfire risk assessment.

articles.title_zh: 基于 TLS 点云高斯分解和重叠度量的燃料层垂直连续性特征
articles.content_zh: 垂直的森林结构通过调节底层到顶层的燃料互联互通来影响火灾行为,然而实用的燃料型模型通过离散分类来代表这种复杂性,这些分类只能间接地捕捉垂直连续性. 高密度点云为更明确和持续地描述纵向燃料互联互通提供了机会,但仍需要具体的方法。 我们把高斯分解法应用到从地面激光扫描(TLS)点云所得出的垂直高度剖面中,跨越25个永久森林地块,以描述几何垂直燃料连续性。 进行了从图幅到~0.5m^2美元单位的多尺度分析,以评估几何、概率和燃料层特征的重叠度量。 该方法复制了灌木层和树层之间的垂直过渡,不同分析水平的皮尔逊相关系数中位数从0.83到0.96. 概率密度与指标和可分离性指标(如Jeffries-Matusita距离)重叠,提供了纵向连续性的补充说明。 中间空间尺度(3-6米细胞)为空间细节和灌木-冠状相互作用模式的一致表现提供了有益的折衷。 由于点密度降低和剖面不规则,更细的尺度增加了可变性,而且发现作为唯一业绩指标的低平方差值不足。 应用于TLS点云的高斯分解能够对垂直燃料连续性进行明确的量化,这是当前离散分类系统的限制. 从这一方法中得出的持续的纵向互联互通指标为改进梯级燃料特性和加强野火风险评估中的决策支持提供了一个途径。

articles.title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
articles.content: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 变化环境中的可视多场会议登记控制器
articles.content_zh: 重复的机器人监测需要通过访问同一环境实现本地化,即使环境发生变化. 这种变化可以大大减少持续的视觉内容,重复的结构可能导致不正确的跨会话通信. 在本文中,我们将新数据记录(查询会话)的可视多会场登记与以前重建的参考地图联系起来。 在巨大的视觉和结构变化下,可能只能对部分轨迹进行跨会场定位. 因此,在我们的方法中,我们依赖一套稀少的可靠绝对制约,并将这些制约与会期内相对拥有的信息结合起来,以记录参考地图的完整轨迹。 我们首先通过视觉位置识别,局部特征匹配,几何校验来估计绝对对齐假设. 然后我们用序列共识来拒绝与常见的查询对引用对齐不一致的假设,并保留剩下的姿势作为绝对锚. 这些锚通过对准高斯语特征域的特征调整加以改进,并在强势的姿势图优化中与会内相对占有的限制相结合。 我们从具有挑战性的HILTI26建筑站点数据集中评估了我们在15个跨场实验上的做法,这些实验涉及重大场景变化和难以匹配的环境。 我们的方法在1米以内召回94.4%,在5米以内召回100.0%,超过独立图像本地化,分别达到65.3%和70.7%的最高点,以及直接登记独立重建的结构-从运动几何。 我们的结果表明,即使只有部分查询会话才有可靠的跨会话信函,但很少、可靠的绝对锚可以提供准确和完整的轨迹登记。

articles.title: Manifold Embedding of Deep Image Features for Image Matching via Neural Adjoint Maps
articles.content: Estimating semantic correspondences between different object instances of similar categories in real-world images is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. While the recent progress in foundation models has significantly advanced solutions for such difficult image correspondence problems, respective methods are often insufficiently regularised. For example, common nearest-neighbour matching with foundation model features often results in noisy correspondences, which is particularly prominent when solving for dense correspondences. In this work, we tackle image matching via functional maps, which have been popularised for 3D shape matching due to their powerful spectral formalism utilising an efficient low-dimensional linear representation. However, functional maps require that domains (in our cases the rectangular image grids) are equipped with an informative and non-trivial geometry. To define a meaningful manifold structure for images, we use Galerkin's method from finite elements to derive a discrete Laplace-Beltrami operator (LBO) based on a manifold embedding of deep image features. Further, we leverage a neural adjoint map that allows to represent non-linear mappings. We demonstrate that our method sets the new state of the art among zero-shot image correspondence methods on multiple dense correspondence benchmarks of real-world images. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/NafieAmrani/NAMI
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Manifold 通过神经辅助地图嵌入深图像特性进行图像匹配
articles.content_zh: 估计现实世界图像中类似类别的不同对象实例之间的语义对应是计算机视觉中的一个根本挑战. 虽然最近在基础模型方面取得的进展大大推动了解决这些难以解决的图像对应问题,但各种方法往往不够规范。 例如,常见的近邻与基础模型特征的匹配往往导致杂音通信,在解决稠密通信时尤为突出. 在这部作品中,我们通过功能地图处理图像匹配问题,由于这些图具有强大的光谱形式,利用高效的低维线性表现,因此3D形状匹配已被普及. 然而,功能图要求域(就我们的情况而言,是长方形图像网格)配备信息丰富且非三角几何. 为了定义图像的有意义的多重结构,我们用Galerkin的方法从有限的元素中得出一个离散的Laplace-Beltrami操作符(LBO),基于深层图像特征的多重嵌入. 此外,我们利用一个能代表非线性绘图的神经连接图。 我们证明,我们的方法将新艺术定位在零镜头图像对应方法中,在现实世界图像的多重密集对应基准上. 我们的代码可公开查阅:https://github.com/NafieAmrani/NAMI

articles.title: Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 " 推出自由世界 " 模式对端到端自主驾驶进行轨迹评价
articles.content_zh: 虽然现有的候选轨迹评价员大大提高了端到端规划的准确性,但其基本机制仍然不够理想。 基于模型的评价人员通常通过明确预测在规划范围内具备候选人条件的未来状态,从而对未来作出评分,我们称之为推出。 然而,推展费用高昂,并累积了预测错误。 我们认为,规划并不需要为每个候选人重建一个完整的未来场景,而只需要与未来有关的资料,以便进行可靠的比较。 因此,我们提议采用RFWorld,即 " 推出自由世界 " 模式,进行端到端轨迹评价。 RFWorld构建了共享场景内存,并通过轻量级的训练-时空读取,在语义学监督下将其塑造为未来可读的代表,使训练管理水平保持低水平. 推算时,候选轨迹通过稀疏的空间读出直接查询共享内存进行评分,将计算大致缩短规划视野的候选轨迹数量,同时避免递归式推出错误. 关于NAVSIM和Bench2Drive的实验表明,RFWorld学习了更符合规划的世界代表性,并取得了最新业绩.

articles.title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VIGOR:在多式联运散射语言模型中为缓解幻觉而进行视觉增益排序
articles.content_zh: 多式联运离散散式语言模型(dLLMs)通过迭代掩码预测产生响应,为自递式大型视觉语言模型提供了一个有希望的替代方案. 然而,他们仍然受到幻觉的影响,其产出在语言前言中是可信的,但是在形象上没有足够扎根。 我们提出,在多式联运 dLLMs 中的幻觉不仅是一个象征性的预测问题,而且是一个过早的承诺问题:在迭代解密期间,一些蒙面的立场被揭开太早,因为其信心更多地是由语言前身而不是视觉证据驱动的,这些早期的承诺会偏向后代. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了Visual Gain Ordering(VIGOR),这是一种没有训练的插头和游戏推论策略,根据反事实的视觉证据重新排列蒙面位置. 在每一个解密步骤上,VIGOR在原图像条件的通行证和额外的视觉缩写通行证下比较每个候选信使的自信,并优先排列其预测得到图像更有力支持的位置. 关于LLaDA-V和Lumina-DimoO的实验表明,VIGOR不断减少幻觉,提高跨基准的多式联运推理性能. 代码见https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

articles.title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
articles.content: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FloMo: 三维场景流作为学习人类视频的世界行动模式中间体
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的视频生成模型将互联网尺度的运动前身提炼成机器人政策,但完整的视频是动作预测的冗余信号. 我们主张,密集的3D运动是视频预先训练对机器人动作的最佳转移的媒介,而预测运动而不是视频能为动作预测提供更好的样本效率. FloMo是一个5B视频生成模型的微调,用于预测3D场景流和动作符. 将场景流作为RGB进行渲染,并将其编码为与视频相同的潜伏空间,使得预先训练的视频生成主干能够高效地适应以预测3D场景流. 我们的模型从人类影视预演中获得了好处, 以视频预测目标取代运动预测可降解分配外的泛化,同时在运动的同时增加一个视频预测目标会降低而不是改善政策成功. 当运动、视频和行动被联合预测时,动作符号比视频要多得多,这表明了预测视频废物模型的能力。 这些结果表明,运动有效地调解了从视频预训到行动的转移。 更多信息见flomo-wam.github.io。

articles.title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
articles.content: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理政策需要看每个步骤吗? 理由和行动的几何摘要
articles.content_zh: 近期的多模式语言模型可以直接对机器人场景进行解释,但不清楚它们是否需要在互动的每一个步骤中反复重新解释原始视觉观察. 我们建议将常规的空间推理从图像转移到文字和符号上,通过从局部观察中刷新出来并由语言模型直接读取的三维几何抽象. 具体地说,我们的界面通过打字、有证据意识的象征意义地提及物体部件,使这些部件无法校准RGB-D,并在每次行动后返回带有度量剩余值的紧凑文本检查站。 因此,符号性任务结构可以在各种决定中重复使用,而衡量值则在反弹到目前的场景,只有根据需要才直接引用视觉推理。 纵观离线政策综合和连续的在线执行,对基于基础的文字和符号的推理可以改进多步骤的操纵完成,同时大大减少重复的多式联运查询,将明确的几何状态定位为代理机器人政策的有效底物。

articles.title: On the Learnability of Footwear Robustness: Footstep Recognition Under Unseen Conditions
articles.content: Footstep patterns, captured using pressure or force-sensitive walkways during natural walking, offer a convenient and passive approach to biometric recognition. However, footwear variability poses a major challenge to practical deployment, as it impacts both the foot-sensor interface and the user's underlying gait mechanics. This study considers the particularly difficult scenario where users enroll under one fixed footwear condition but must later be recognized in arbitrary, unseen footwear. Using the StepUP-P150 dataset, we show that footwear-induced shift, while substantial and heterogeneous across individuals, contains shared structure that can be learned from a training population and transferred, zero-shot, to previously unseen users and footwear styles. We do this using BiStepNet, a novel architecture that decomposes spatial and temporal identity cues into independently trainable streams and outperforms compact 3D spatiotemporal baselines for cross-footwear recognition. We demonstrate that cross-footwear recognition performance scales systematically with the volume and diversity of footwear representation in the training set, with gains transferring to footwear styles not directly observed during training. Moreover, we show that auxiliary gait datasets with only partial modality overlap (incorporated through the architecture's decomposed design) can be leveraged to further improve robustness to unseen footwear conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于学习脚套强健性:在不明条件下的脚步识别
articles.content_zh: 脚步模式,在自然行走过程中使用压力或对力敏感的走道捕捉,为生物鉴别提供了方便和被动的方法. 然而,鞋类的可变性对实际部署构成重大挑战,因为它既影响到脚感应器接口,也影响到用户的基本速度力学。 这项研究考虑了一种特别困难的情况,即用户在一个固定的鞋类条件下注册,但必须后来在任意的、看不见的鞋类中得到承认。 使用StepUP-P150数据集,我们显示鞋类引发的转变,虽然在个人之间是实质性的和多样的,但包含从培训人群中可以学到的共享结构,并且可以零镜头地转移到以前看不见的用户和鞋类风格. 我们使用BiStepNet来完成这项工作,这个新颖的架构将空间和时间身份提示分解成独立可训练的溪流,并超越紧凑的3D spatiotemporal基线,用于跨脚衣识别. 我们表明,跨足鞋类识别性能表随着培训中鞋类代表的数量和多样性而系统化,其收益转移到了鞋类样式,在培训期间没有直接观察到。 此外,我们表明,仅部分方式重叠(通过架构的分解设计并入)的辅助步态数据集可以被利用来进一步提高稳健性,使其适应看不见的鞋类条件。

articles.title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
articles.content: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合胶片下医疗图像分类联邦转移学习
articles.content_zh: 医学成像方面的深入学习受到数据稀缺和隐私条例的限制,这些条例使将病人数据集中到各机构的做法不切实际。 联邦学习(FL)通过保持数据本地化来解决这些制约因素,但其分布性质使培训暴露于统计高度异质性。 多中心医学数据尤其受到影响,显示出一种混合的SKW,将特征、标签、概念和数量跨中心变化结合起来。 个性化的FL通过为每个客户量身定做一个模型来缓解异质性,然而大多数方法都假设从零开始训练,这不现实,因为相对于有限的数据,医疗特征的维度很高. 我们提出了个性化的Aligner Federation Pretrained(PAFP)框架,这是一种建立在一个预先培训的骨干基础上的个性化的FL方法. PAFP 在微调的块之前插入客户端特异性对齐模块,以调整隐藏的特性分布到服务器汇总的目标. 在FedISIC基准上,PAFP取得了最高的未加权平衡准确度,同时相对最强基线减少了大约6倍的客户间业绩差异,从而产生了准确度和共同的跨客户权益。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP上公开查阅。

articles.title: RGB Photo Enhancement with Deep Learning on Smartphone GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report
articles.content: On-device RGB photo enhancement is a popular task that is needed for quality improvement of photos captured with mobile devices as well as for retouching of images acquired through other sources. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose participants to design fast solutions that can perform comprehensive enhancement of RGB photos while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale DPED dataset consisting of RGB image pairs captured with an old iPhone 3GS smartphone and a professional Canon 70D DSLR camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to enhance Full HD resolution RGB images on both platforms under 300 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RGB 图片增强与智能手机上的深度学习 GPU:移动AI 2026挑战报告
articles.content_zh: On-device RGB照片增强是一项流行的任务,是改进用移动设备拍摄的照片的质量以及通过其他来源获取的图像进行重新校正所必需的. 这就需要为这一问题建立高效的深层学习模式,这些模式不仅能够发挥作用,而且还可以部署在有限的移动硬件上。 在这项Mobile AI挑战中,我们解决这一问题,并提议参与者设计快速解决方案,在运行来自Qualcomm和Arm的流行智能手机GPU的同时,能够全面增强RGB照片. 为此,向与会者提供了一套大型的DPED数据集,包括用一台旧的iPhone 3GS智能手机和一台专业的Canon 70D DSLR相机捕获的RGB图像对. 所有型号的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片上分别与阿德雷诺和马里GPU进行了评价. 在这项挑战中提出的顶峰解决方案能够增强两个平台上300毫秒以下的全HD分辨率RGB图像. 本文件全面介绍了挑战中开发的模式。

articles.title: Can saliency maps flag chest radiograph classifier errors at a new hospital? An external validation study
articles.content: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 显赫的地图能标出新医院的胸部放射图分类错误吗? 外部验证研究
articles.content_zh: 作为医疗图像分类员的一种保障措施,提供了显著的地图,但是否在新医院发现个别错误基本上仍未经过测试。 我们在NIH ChestX-ray14上培训了一个革命网络和一个视觉变压器,并在训练医院和在美国和越南的两个外部地点对每个模型的303,768项决定进行了评估,并贴上了放射学家-共识标签。 我们通过解剖学的浓缩来分解每个解释, 分解的胸膜区域中归属的区域常态化浓度, 测试它是否检测出超出模型信任范围的错误。 与放射学家相比,Crad-CAM本地化发现的频率较低(受虐率最高为0.575比0.888)。 将浓缩加在训练医院校准的基于信任的错误探测器上,从未将其曲线下的区域提升过0.011以上,对于进化网络来说,浓缩与正确之间的关系在医院之间发生逆转,使转移的探测器退化。 模型信任,而不是显著性,应作为部署监测的基础。

articles.title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report
articles.content: With the increasing importance of mobile camera quality in modern smartphones, growing attention has been directed toward computational photography and advanced image signal processing (ISP) algorithms aimed at enhancing various perceptual attributes of captured images. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can reconstruct RGB photos from RAW Bayer camera data while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale Fujifilm UltraISP dataset consisting of RAW-RGB image pairs captured with the Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer mobile sensor and a professional 102MP medium format FujiFilm GFX100 camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to reconstruct high-quality 5MP RGB image from raw data on both platforms under 100 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

articles.title_zh: 关于移动GPU的学习智能手机ISP:移动AI 2026 挑战报告
articles.content_zh: 随着移动相机质量在现代智能手机中日益重要,人们越来越关注计算摄影和先进的图像信号处理算法,目的是增强捕获图像的各种感知属性. 这就需要为这一问题建立高效的深层学习模式,这些模式不仅能够发挥作用,而且还可以部署在有限的移动硬件上。 在这项Mobile AI挑战中,我们解决了这个问题,并提议参与者设计快速解决方案,在运行于来自Qualcomm和Arm的流行智能手机GPU的同时,可以重建RAW Bayer相机数据的RGB照片. 为此,向与会者提供了一个大型的Fujifilm UltraISP数据集,其中包括用索尼IMX586Quad Bayer移动传感器捕获的RAW-RGB图像对,以及专业的102MP中型格式的FujiFilm GFX100相机. 所有型号的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片上分别与阿德雷诺和马里GPU进行了评价. 在这项挑战中提出的顶级解决方案能够从两个平台的原始数据中重建100毫秒以下的高质量5MP RGB图像. 本文件全面介绍了挑战中开发的模式。

articles.title: ScoreDial: Precise Control of Visual Attributes in Image Generation via Regressor Guidance from Limited Human Ratings
articles.content: Requested-value control is stricter than continuous steering: given $c$ on a human-rating scale, the generated image should attain that value from only limited ratings. We present ScoreDial, which fits a differentiable regressor $R$ to 100-479 human-rated images; once $R$ is fixed, a requested value $c$ is defined on its output scale, and learned target conditioning is paired with error-adaptive guidance that repeatedly reduces $|R(\mathbf{x})-c|$ during sampling. Across tire slip resistance, interior visual complexity, food desire-to-eat, and soap translucency, using one set of sampler settings shared across all four, ScoreDial reaches requested values and achieves, on all four attributes, $R$-MAE at most 0.013 over a range of width 0.8 and Spearman $ρ=0.980$, the maximum attainable under our evaluation protocol. Because $R$ also drives sampling, we evaluate agreement with $R$ separately from matched sweeps, an independent auditor fitted to the same ratings on a backbone none of the deployed regressors uses, and blinded human judgments. MPGD-flow also reaches the requested values under $R$, but ScoreDial has larger auditor displacement on every attribute, the largest among all compared methods, and a stronger MPGD-flow setting gives up target agreement without closing this gap. On every attribute, removing target conditioning leaves low $R$-MAE but more than halves auditor displacement, separating precise score correction from attribute movement. Blinded rating studies with 15 raters per attribute show that mean human ratings track $c$ on tire and soap, with linear $R^2=0.665$ and $R^2=0.786$, and in forced-choice comparisons of matched sweeps, raters chose ScoreDial's as the clearer progression in at least 84% of judgments against every baseline.
