articles.title_zh: 分数分数:通过有限人类分数的递归器指导,精确控制图像生成中的视觉属性
articles.content_zh: 要求的数值控制比连续方向更严格:如果按人定级计算,生成的图像只能从有限的评级中获得这一数值。 我们提出的是分数Dial,它符合一个不同的递归器,相当于100-479美元;一旦确定美元,就在其输出尺度上定义了要求的美元,所学习的目标条件与在取样时反复减少美元R(\mathb{x})-c|的适应错误的指南对齐。 在轮胎滑动阻力、内视复杂度、食物欲食性和肥皂半透明性方面,使用所有四个国家共享的一套采样器设置,计分仪达到所要求的值,并在所有四个属性上达到最大0.013雷亚尔的MAE,宽度为0.8,斯皮尔曼为0.980美元,这是我们评价协议下可达到的最高值。 由于R$也驱动着抽样,我们评价与R$的协议与匹配的扫荡分开,独立审计员在部署的倒退者没有使用过的骨干上达到同样的评级,以及蒙蔽人类判断。 MPGD流量也达到要求值的R$,但ScoreDial在每个属性上都有较大的审计人员置换,是所有比较方法中最大的一个,更强大的MPGD流量设置在不弥补这一缺口的情况下放弃了目标协议. 在每个属性上,去除目标条件会留下较低的R$-MAE,但超过一半的审计员置换,将精确的分数校正与属性运动区分开来. 盲目评级研究,每个属性有15个评分,显示人类的评分轨迹为轮胎和肥皂,线性为R^2=0.665美元和R^2=0.786美元,在强制选择对匹配的扫射进行比较时,评分者选择ScoreDial's作为至少84%的判断比每个基线更清晰的进展.

articles.title: ProAlign: Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
articles.content: Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification (AG-ReID) aims to match pedestrian images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task remains highly challenging due to severe viewpoint discrepancies, frequent occlusions, and substantial domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. Beyond these observable factors, existing methods often overlook two fundamental structural issues: cumulative positional drift during hierarchical feature extraction and semantic inconsistency across cross-view feature distributions. To address these challenges, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID. ProAlign comprises two key components: a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE performs adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer layers by employing conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while introducing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce global semantic priors. Meanwhile, PCL maintains view-specific aerial and ground prototypes for each identity and enforces cross-view semantic consistency via a dual-prototype contrastive objective. Extensive experiments on CARGO and two real-world AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProAlign, achieving state-of-the-art overall retrieval performance on CARGO with improvements of 1.60% in Rank-1 accuracy and 5.01% in mAP over the strongest competing methods.

articles.title_zh: ProAlign:对空轮人员重新识别的渐进定位和原型指引
articles.content_zh: Air-Ground Person Re-Identification(AG-ReID)旨在匹配无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)和地面监视摄像机捕获的行人图像. 由于存在严重的观点差异、经常被隔离以及空中和地面图像之间有很大的域位差距,这项任务仍然具有很大的挑战性。 除了这些可观察到的因素之外,现有方法往往忽略了两个基本的结构问题:等级特征提取过程中的累积位置漂移和跨视图特征分布的语义不一致。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议为AG-ReID建立一个进步立场和原型指导性对接网络。 ProAlign包含两个关键组成部分:一个面向层的累进定位嵌入模块(LPPE)和一个View-Aware原型对比学习模块(PCL). LPPE在整个变压器层中进行适应性定位校准,在浅层中采用条件性定位编码来缓解局部空间扭曲,同时在更深层中引入可学习的静态定位嵌入,强化全球语义前缀. 同时,PCL为每个身份保持了针对特定视域的空中和地面原型,并通过双原型对比目标执行交叉视域语义一致性. 关于CARGO和两个现实世界的AG-ReID基准的广泛实验表明ProAlign的有效性,在CARGO上实现了最先进的整体检索性能,比最强的相互竞争方法提高了1.60%的Rank-1精度和5.01%的mAP.

articles.title: An Agentic Framework for Quality-Aware and Scenario-Adaptive Image Compression
articles.content: Despite decades of progress, image codecs remain difficult to adapt to diverse real-world compression scenarios for two main reasons. First, most image codecs are optimized for a specific objective and require substantial redevelopment when the compression goal changes. Second, they typically assume clean inputs, whereas sensor-captured images often contain degradations that alter rate-quality behavior. To address these challenges, we propose Practical Image Coding Agents (PICA), a multi-agent framework that adapts existing codecs to diverse user requirements and potentially degraded inputs. PICA consists of four collaborative agents: a Perception agent that interprets user intent and analyzes image content, an Improvement agent that jointly considers bitrate and reconstruction quality to guide pre-coding restoration, a Coding agent that refines quality-control settings from global to regional levels, and an After-coding improvement agent that addresses residual degradations and compression-induced artifacts through restoration guided solely by image quality. To enable codec-agnostic regional adaptation, we introduce Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC), which treats the codec as a black box and allows the agent to automatically schedule, execute, evaluate, and reflect ROI coding plans without architectural modifications or codec-specific retraining. We integrate these four agents with a Scenario-Guided Quality-Rate (SGQR) evaluation strategy to enable more effective scenario-adaptive compression across heterogeneous codecs. Comprehensive experiments on clean, noisy, and blurred images across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression scenarios demonstrate that PICA consistently enhances the compression performance of both the conventional H.266/VVC codec and the neural Cheng2020 codec, outperforming competing compression methods on the Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC datasets.

articles.title_zh: 质量智能和情景图像压缩代理框架
articles.content_zh: 尽管取得了几十年的进步,图像解码器仍然难以适应多种多样的现实世界压缩情景,主要原因有二. 首先,大多数图像解码器都是为特定的目标进行优化,在压缩目标改变时需要进行实质性的再开发. 其次,它们通常假定是干净的输入,而传感器捕获的图像往往含有可改变速率质量行为的退化。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用实用图像编码代理(PICA)这一多代理框架,使现有的编码器适应不同的用户要求和可能退化的投入。 PICA由四个协作剂组成:一个解释用户意图和分析图像内容的感知剂,一个共同考虑比特率和重建质量以指导编码前恢复的改进剂,一个完善从全球到区域各级质量控制设置的编码剂,以及一个通过完全以图像质量为指导的恢复来解决残余降解和压缩引起的文物的编码后改进剂. 为了实现代码不可知的区域适应,我们引入了Agentic ROI Coding(AROIC),它把代码作为黑匣子处理,并且允许代理在不进行建筑修改或特定代码再培训的情况下,自动安排,执行,评价和反映ROI编码计划. 我们把这4种药剂与“设想”-指导质量-Rate(SGQR)评价战略结合起来,以便更有效地对各种编码器进行情景调整压缩。 有关清洁、吵闹和模糊的图像的全面实验,跨越标准、感知和机器视觉压缩情景,表明PICA一贯加强传统的H.266/VVC编码器和神经程2020编码器的压缩性能,在Kodak、CLIC2020和HEVC数据集上的表现超过了相互竞争的压缩方法。

articles.title: Lightweight graph transformers for clutter and target classification in automotive radar
articles.content: Radar is a core sensor modality for scene perception to achieve higher levels of autonomy in automotive driving. A common occurrence in automotive radars is clutter - detections of non-existent moving objects, that can adversely impact target detection and classification performance and subsequent driving actions. We propose lightweight tiny graph transformer network (TGTNet) models for classifying clutter from stationary and moving targets in the scene. Performance evaluation on the public RadarScenes show that our proposed TGTNet models achieve similar classification performance in precision and recall metrics in comparison to state of the art models, with one to two orders of magnitude lower model size and significantly faster inference.

articles.title_zh: 轻量级图变压器,用于汽车雷达的整流和目标分类
articles.content_zh: 雷达是场景感知的一种核心传感器模式,可以实现更高的汽车驾驶自主性. 汽车雷达中常见的现象是杂乱无章的----对不存在的移动物体的探测,这可能对目标探测和分类性能以及随后的驾驶动作产生不利影响。 我们提出轻量级微小的图变压器网络(TGTNet)模型,用于从场景中的固定和移动目标进行杂乱分类. 对公共雷达场景的性能评价显示,我们提议的TGTNet模型在精确度和召回度量表方面与最新模型相比取得了相似的分类性能,模型大小低一至两个数量级,推论明显更快.

articles.title: DPAGait: Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Network for Robust Gait Recognition in the Wild
articles.content: Gait biometrics aims at identity recognition by appearance or pose features captured during unconstrained human walking. Existing methods predominantly rely on binary silhouette images, inherently characterized by low information entropy, and fail to fully utilize the dynamic information in gait sequences, limiting their ability to handle cross-time variations effectively. Consequently, these methods encounter significant challenges in the wild. They are susceptible to variations in clothing, carried objects, and viewpoints, as well as dynamic environmental conditions, all of which lead to substantial degradation in recognition accuracy and robustness. To overcome these challenges, we propose a pose-knowledge-aware approach specifically designed for robust gait recognition in the wild. First, we propose a novel Dynamic Pose-Parsing enhanced Silhouette gait representation paradigm that substantially enhances the information entropy and effectively captures fine-grained behavioral cues by integrating pose-parsing cues with traditional silhouettes. Subsequently, we develop a dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait network. The framework consists of two complementary branches: (1) a 2D dynamic pose-aware branch that extracts pose-enhanced features from our proposed DPPS representations, and (2) a 3D Skinned Multi-Person Linear branch that leverages the 3D SMPL model to capture rich and comprehensive 3D dynamic pose information. Finally, the features are integrated to facilitate accurate and robust gait recognition. Extensive experiments on four challenging in-the-wild gait datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed DPPS representation. The complete framework is further evaluated on SUSTech1K, CCPG, and Gait3D, where SMPL information is available or can be consistently estimated, achieving competitive performance under diverse real-world conditions.

articles.title_zh: DPAGait:野生强力盖特识别动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware网络
articles.content_zh: 盖特生物鉴别技术旨在通过外表识别身份,或在不受限制的人类行走过程中所捕捉到的特征。 现有方法主要依靠二进制的silhouette图像,其内在特征为低信息 en,未能充分利用步态序列中的动态信息,限制了它们有效处理跨时变异的能力. 因此,这些方法在野外遇到重大挑战。 它们易受服装、携带物体和观点以及动态环境条件变化的影响,所有这些都导致识别准确性和稳健性大幅退化。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议一种姿态知识意识办法,专门用来在野外强有力地迅速承认。 首先,我们提出一个新的动态Pose-Parsing增强Silhouette gait代表范式,通过将姿势平缓提示与传统的Silhouette组合起来,大大增强信息 en,有效地捕捉到精细的行为提示. 随后,我们开发了双分支动态Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait网络. 框架由两个互补分支组成:(1)一个2D动态姿态意识分支,从我们拟议的DPPS表达中提取了姿势增强的特征;(2)一个3D皮肤多人线分支,利用3D SMPL模型获取丰富全面的3D动态呈现信息. 最后,这些特征被综合起来,以促进准确和有力的进度识别。 对四个具有挑战性的 " 快速 " 数据集进行的广泛试验表明,拟议的DPPS代表具有效力和普遍性。 完整的框架将在SUSTech1K、CCPG和Gait3D上得到进一步评价,那里有SMPL信息或能够一致估计,在不同的现实世界条件下实现竞争业绩。

articles.title: PATTS: Parallel-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Thought-Image Generation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion LLMs
articles.content: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generative models by allocating additional inference-time computation to sampling, search, and verification. Existing image generation approaches, however, typically rank completed images or image-centric intermediate states. We study TTS for parallel multimodal discrete diffusion language models, in which reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly within a single generation trajectory. We first diagnose a limitation of conventional final-image selection: on GenEval, a CLIP-style image-prompt score is weakly aligned with within-prompt compositional correctness, leaving substantial headroom between verifier selection and oracle selection. We then propose PATTS, a novel parallel-aware TTS framework that searches over intermediate thought-image states using cross-modal verifier signals. PATTS uses a state-dependent reliability weight, derived from model-internal trajectory diagnostics, to modulate the influence of external semantic verification during generation. In the fixed N=32 evaluation on MMaDA-Parallel, the PATTS reaches a GenEval score of 0.844, compared with 0.628 without TTS, 0.787 for Best-of-N, and 0.810 for FKD. These results show that reliability-aware trajectory verification can improve test-time selection for parallel thought-image co-generation under the evaluated search budget. Our code release is at https://github.com/Ringo-Star/PATTS.git

articles.title_zh: PATTS: 多式联运中思维图像生成的平行-智能测试-时间缩放
articles.content_zh: 测试时间缩放(TTS)通过将额外的推论时间计算分配给采样,搜索和核实来改进基因模型. 然而,现有的图像生成方法通常对已完成的图像或以图像为中心的中间状态进行排序。 我们研究平行的多模式离散扩散语言模型的TTS,其中推理符号和图像符号在一个一代的轨迹中共同解码. 我们首先诊断出传统最终图像选择的局限性:在GenEval上,一个CLIP风格的图像瞬间分数与瞬间内部的构成正确性相差很弱,在核查者选择和甲骨文选择之间留下了实质性的头室. 然后,我们提出PATTS,这是一个新的平行认识TTS框架,利用跨模式核查信号搜索中间思维-图像状态。 PATTS使用一种从模型-内部轨迹诊断推导出来的状态依赖性可靠性重量,在生成过程中调节外部语义验证的影响. 在对MMADA-Parallel的固定N=32评价中,PATTS达到了0.844的GenEval分数,相比之下,没有TTS的GenEval分数为0.628分,最佳N分数为0.787分,FKD为0.810分. 这些结果表明,对可靠性的认识轨迹的核查可以改进在评估的搜索预算下对平行思维图像共生成的测试时间选择。 我们的代码发布在 https://github.com/Ringo-Star/PATTS.git

articles.title: How Well Does Webcam Eye Tracking Work "in the Wild"? A Large-Scale Validation of Chiasm and a Comparison with WebGazer
articles.content: Webcam eye tracking can greatly accelerate data collection in basic and applied research by reaching large, diverse samples of participants online. However, its spatial performance is considered well below that of hardware-based systems, limiting its use. We evaluated the first-generation Chiasm webcam eye tracker in a large online study ($N = 505$) spanning diverse participants, devices, and recording conditions. Chiasm achieved a mean spatial accuracy of 2.39 cm ($\approx 2.28^\circ$ at 60 cm), spatial precision (SD) of 1.05 cm ($\approx 1.00^\circ$ at 60 cm), and sample-to-sample precision (RMS-S2S) of 1.29 cm ($\approx 1.23^\circ$ at 60 cm). For the 91% of participants who met a 3 cm calibration criterion, spatial accuracy was 2.15 cm ($\approx 2.05^\circ$ at 60 cm). After three minutes of a task that encouraged head movement, spatial accuracy declined by 0.59 cm, while the gaze center at each target shifted by a mean distance of only 0.37 cm. On the validation block, the offset was 0.30 cm larger for men than for women. Age, region of residence, face luminance, and Michelson contrast showed no reliable relationship with spatial accuracy. A higher eye aspect ratio, a more open eye, was associated with a smaller offset. Wearing glasses decreased spatial accuracy on every validation block. In a comparison between a random subsample ($N = 101$) and a separate sample tested with the open-source tracker WebGazer ($N = 101$) using an identical protocol, Chiasm showed better spatial accuracy (2.18 vs. 4.51 cm) and spatial precision (SD; 1.01 vs. 1.55 cm). WebGazer showed better sample-to-sample precision (RMS-S2S; 0.79 vs. 1.26 cm), which likely reflects conservative, over-smoothed estimates rather than superior stability. These results suggest that Chiasm is narrowing the gap between webcam and hardware-based eye tracking, making large-scale gaze research "in the wild" a reality.

articles.title_zh: "在野外"的Webcam眼睛追踪工作如何?. Chiasm 大范围验证和与 WebGazer 的比较
articles.content_zh: 网络摄像头眼跟踪可以通过在线接触大量多样的参与者样本,大大加快基础和应用研究的数据收集。 然而,其空间性能被认为远远低于硬件系统,限制了其使用. 我们评价了第一代Chiasm网络摄像头追踪器, Chiasm的空间平均精度为2.39厘米(约2.28美元,60厘米),空间精度为1.05厘米(约1.00美元,60厘米),样本至样本精度为1.29厘米(约1.23美元,60厘米)。 91%的参与者达到3厘米校准标准,空间精度为2.15厘米(约合2.05美元,60厘米)。 经过三分钟的鼓励头部运动的任务,空间精度下降了0.59厘米,而每个目标的凝视中心转动平均距离只有0.37厘米. 在验证块上,男性的抵消比女性大0.30厘米. 年龄,居住地,面部光辉,米歇尔森对比显示与空间精确度没有可靠的关系. 眼宽比较高,眼睛更开阔,与较小的偏差有关。 戴眼镜降低了每个验证块的空间精度. 在随机子样本(N = 101美元)与使用相同协议的开源跟踪器WebGazer(N = 101美元)测试的单独样本的比较中,Chiasm显示的空间精度(2.18对4.51厘米)和空间精度(SD;1.01对1.55厘米)较好. WebGazer显示样本至样本精度较好(RMS-S2S;0.79 vs. 1.26 cm),这很可能反映保守的,过沉的估算,而不是优越的稳定性. 这些结果表明,Chiasm正在缩小网络摄像头和基于硬件的眼线跟踪之间的差距,使得大规模凝视研究"野外"成为现实.

articles.title: Learning Where to Look: Observation Policy Optimization for Thinking with Images
articles.content: Complex visual question answering often requires vision-language models to think with images, i.e., actively acquire local visual evidence by zooming into informative regions of high-resolution images. Our error analysis shows that many failures in this setting originate from incorrect observation actions, where the model fails to localize key regions or obtain crops that contain sufficient evidence for answering. We further observe that bounding-box tokens exhibit substantially higher generation entropy than ordinary language tokens, indicating high uncertainty when the model decides where to look. However, existing reinforcement learning methods based on final-answer rewards provide only trajectory-level feedback, making it difficult to assign precise credit to the observation actions. We propose Observation Policy Optimization (OPO), an RL algorithm for optimizing observation actions in tool-augmented thinking with images. OPO consists of two core modules. First, Uncertainty-Guided Observation Branching (UOB) treats each image zoom-in tool call as an observation event and selectively branches at high-uncertainty, low-redundancy events during rollout, enabling efficient exploration of alternative cropping decisions and their resulting visual evidence. Second, Evidence-Localized Advantage Attribution (ELAA) compares sibling branches using local evidence-sufficiency rewards and assigns credit only to the corresponding observation-action tokens. By decoupling observation-action optimization from trajectory-level outcome supervision, OPO improves visual evidence acquisition and further enhances visual reasoning performance. Experiments show that OPO consistently improves Qwen3-VL models across scales and achieves competitive performance against larger models and tool-augmented baselines. Code is publicly available.

articles.title_zh: 学习向何处看:观察政策优化与图像思维
articles.content_zh: 复杂的视觉问题回答往往需要视觉语言模型与图像进行思考,即通过将高分辨率图像放大到信息化区域来积极获取局部视觉证据. 我们的错误分析表明,这种情况下的许多失败源于不正确的观测行动,即模型未能将关键区域本地化或获得含有足够证据的作物来回答. 我们进一步注意到,边框式符号显示的生成均质比普通语言符号要高很多,这表明当模型决定看哪里时,高度不确定性。 然而,基于最终答案奖励的现有强化学习方法只提供轨迹层面的反馈,使得观察行动很难得到准确的功劳. 我们提出观测政策优化(OPO),这是在以图像为工具的思维中优化观测行动的RL算法. OPO由两个核心模块组成. 首先,不确定性指导观测分支(UOB)将每个图像缩放工具调用视为观测事件,并在推出时的高度不确定性和低冗余性活动中有选择地将图像调用视为观测事件,从而能够有效探索替代作物决定及其产生的视觉证据。 第二,证据本地化优势分配(LEAA)利用当地证据充足性奖励来比较兄弟会分支,只给相应的观察行动标志发放信用. 通过将观测-动作优化与轨迹级结果监督脱钩,OPO改进了视觉证据获取,进一步提高了视觉推理性能. 实验显示,OPO不断改进跨尺度的Quen3-VL模型,并实现与更大的模型和工具增强基线相比的竞争性性能. 守则公开发布。

articles.title: HTNN-MSC: Multi-view Subspace Clustering with a Hyperbolic Tangent Tensor Low-Rank Surrogate
articles.content: High-order dependencies among views can be modeled by tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) in multi-view subspace clustering. However, the tensor nuclear norm often used with this framework assigns the same asymptotic marginal penalty to singular values of different magnitudes, which may excessively shrink dominant components that encode cluster structure. We propose HTNN-MSC, which replaces this norm with a bounded hyperbolic tangent tensor rank surrogate. The surrogate is strictly concave on the positive half-axis and has a Lipschitz continuous derivative. Its marginal penalty decreases as singular values grow. We develop an alternating direction method of multipliers solver in which the tensor subproblem decomposes into scalar frequency-domain shrinkage problems. Safeguarded multi-start Newton iterations and candidate-objective comparison implement the resulting hyperbolic tangent thresholding operator. The shape parameter is scaled by the input spectrum. We also establish o-minimal definability of the augmented objective. Under explicit boundedness, descent, relative-error, and exact-block conditions, the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz framework guarantees convergence of the full sequence to a KKT point. On 23 datasets, HTNN-MSC achieves a mean clustering accuracy of 0.8404 and an average accuracy rank of 2.78 against nine representative methods. Friedman tests and Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon comparisons reveal significant overall differences, although several pairwise differences remain nonsignificant. HTNN-MSC records 19 wins, one tie, and three losses against the convex t-SVD-MSC skeleton. A same-skeleton ablation also shows that the proposed surrogate does not uniformly outperform alternative nonconvex penalties.

articles.title_zh: HTNN- MSC: 多视图子空间集群, 带有超曲折的 Tensor 低角代理
articles.content_zh: 在多视图子空间群集中,视图中的高序依赖性可以通过拉诺单值分解(t-SVD)来建模. 然而,在这个框架中经常使用的拉诺核规范将同样的不对称边刑分配给不同大小的单数,这可能会过度缩小编码集群结构的主导成分. 我们提出HTNN-MSC,它用一个边框的双曲切数拉诺级代位取代这个规范. 替代物在正半轴上严格凸起,并具有利普希茨连续衍生物. 其边际惩罚随着单数的增长而减少. 我们开发了倍数解析器的交替方向方法,其中的拉诺子问题分解为scalar频域缩水问题. 保障多启动的牛顿迭代和候选对象目标比较,执行由此产生的双曲切值阈值操作员. 形状参数由输入谱缩放. 我们还确定了扩大目标的最低可定义性。 在明确的界限、血统、相对反射和确切的块状条件下,Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz框架保证整个序列与KKT点的汇合。 在23个数据集上,HTNN-MSC实现平均集群精度0.8404,平均精度等级为2.78,对9个代表性方法. Friedman测试和Holm调整的Wilcoxon比较显示,总体差异很大,尽管若干对位差异仍然不大。 HTNN-MSC记录19胜,1平,3败于对流的T-SVD-MSC骨架. 同一Skeleton禁酒也表明,拟议的代孕药不能一致地超过替代的非康韦克斯处罚。

articles.title: Robustness Verification against Patch Attacks via Group-Lasso Semidefinite Relaxation
articles.content:
Robustness verification is essential for ensuring the safety and security of neural networks, but current methods focus heavily on
  norm-ball attacks, which do not adequately model typical real-world threats that present physical perturbations, known as patch attacks. A naive approach requires computationally prohibitive enumeration of all possible patch positions. To address the challenge, we propose a novel neural network verification method specialized to the patch-attack threat. Instead of enumerating patch locations, we first model the patch attack with group-wise sparsity and formulate its verification methods as a mixed-integer semidefinite program (MISDP) by applying SDP relaxation to the neural network. We then propose three relaxations, including Group-Lasso relaxation, that remove the integer variables while preserving the sparse, group-wise structure of the original attack, enabling substantially efficient verification. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that the proposed relaxations require less than 3% of the computation time of the original MISDP, while the Group-Lasso relaxation incurs only a 0.34\% average increase in the objective value over the original formulation. Furthermore, Group-Lasso achieves a verified rate of 91%, compared with under 70% for prior methods.

articles.title_zh: 通过小组-拉索半定型放松对补丁袭击进行强力核查
articles.content_zh:
坚固性核查对确保神经网络的安全和安保至关重要,但目前的方法主要侧重于
规范球攻击,不能充分模拟出现物理扰动的典型现实世界威胁,称为补丁攻击. 一种天真的做法需要计算出所有可能的补丁位置,令人望而却步。 为了应对挑战,我们提出一种针对补丁攻击威胁的新型神经网络验证方法. 我们没有列举补丁位置,而是首先将补丁攻击模式化为分组式的溅射,并通过将SDP放松应用到神经网络中来,将其核查方法制定为混合整形半定型程序(MISDP). 然后,我们建议采取三项放松措施,包括集团-拉索放松措施,取消整数变量,同时保留原始攻击的稀疏、分组结构,从而能够有效地进行核查。 我们的经验分析表明,拟议的放松要求不到最初的MISDP的计算时间的3%,而Group-Lasso的放松则仅比最初的表述客观价值平均增加0.34 % 。 此外,Lasso集团核实的比率为91%,而以前采用的方法低于70%。

articles.title: VISTA: Vision-Language Integrated Semantic Triage Architecture for Online Face Clustering in Long Videos
articles.content: Clustering faces by identity in long, continuous video streams is a challenging task that serves as a building block for human-centric video analysis. The majority of existing face clustering models are offline, i.e., they assume the entire data to be available altogether. In many practical scenarios, however, the entire data is either unavailable or poses computational challenges to be processed in its entirety. A handful of online methods that exist rely on geometric visual features and simple thresholding techniques, which fail when the faces exhibit significant appearance variations in long, unconstrained videos. To this end, we present VISTA, the first vision language framework for online face clustering in long videos. VISTA leverages semantic reasoning in a controlled, uncertainty aware fashion to maintain both high cluster purity and long range identity continuity. This makes it robust to the variations in illumination, pose, and costume changes that the faces and characters exhibit in long real world videos. Extensive experiments on the VPCD benchmark dataset (with 15 full episodes from The Big Bang Theory [2007-2019], Buffy the Vampire Slayer [1997-2003], and Sherlock [2010-2017]) demonstrate that VISTA achieves a robust precision and recall balance, consistently improving over the strongest matched online unsupervised baseline (COFC) under identical detector, embeddings, and evaluation protocol. Code and supplementary material: https://github.com/SkyJiashu/VISTA.

articles.title_zh: VISTA:长视频中在线面团集成的视觉-语言集成语义结构
articles.content_zh: 将面孔按身份排列在长而连续的视频流中是一项具有挑战性的任务,是以人为本的视频分析的基石。 大多数现有的面团模型都是离线的,即它们假设整个数据是完全可用的. 然而,在许多实际情景中,整个数据要么无法获得,要么构成需要全部处理的计算挑战。 少数存在的在线方法依赖于几何视觉特征和简单的阈值技术,当面部在长长的,不受约束的视频中表现出显著的外观变化时,这些技术就会失败. 为此,我们提出VISTA,这是在线面团在长视频中的首个视觉语言框架. VISTA以可控,不确定性意识的方式利用语义推理,既保持高集群纯度,又保持远程身份连续性. 这使得它能够坚固地适应真实世界中长长的视频中展现的光线、姿势和服装的变化。 VPCD基准数据集的广泛实验(从"大爆炸理论"[2007-2019],"吸血鬼屠夫"[1997-2003],"夏洛克"[2010-2017])表明,VISTA在相同的探测器,嵌入,以及评价协议下,实现了强大的精度和召回平衡,比最强匹配的在线无监督基线(COFC)持续改善. 代码和补充材料:https://github.com/SkyJiashu/VISTA.

articles.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
articles.content: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

articles.title_zh: 视频生成背后:关于从Kling获得多式联运的观察和见解
articles.content_zh: 视频生成从孤立的片段发展到连贯的短形式视听序列,瓶颈正在从渲染转向语义控制. 本报告总结了几代人对多式联运理解的看法和见解。 我们认为,生成质量是通过整个数据-空调-协调-评价链来预测多式联运理解,我们逐个模块审查这一链条模块。 Kling-MLM是一个共享的多模式基础模型,它统一了图像,视频,音频,同步音频-视频,以及互页输入,为每个下游模块专用. 因为一个DiT的训练样本比语言模型少得多,所以我们把标题作为语义合同来对待,它能使描述密度最大化,并将它扩展至使引用约束明确化的基于参考的字幕. 即时增强能将用户的意向转化为这个标题分发:基本的PE来源于有说服力的视频的字幕,并精炼了文本级别和生成器的即时强化学习,而代理PE则精炼故事并检索有说服力的例子. 我们显示,一个可靠的文本编码器来自知觉训练,而不是更强大的语言能力,在端到端训练之前,可以单独从文本中筛选候选人. 奖励模型配对一个通用的奖励模型,用于解释性,局部性的批评,并带有快速多维评分的决定奖励模型,将感知带宽作为一流的设计参数. 最后,我们审查针对具体任务的自动评估,重点是暴露评分捷径和帮助追踪其上游来源的故障的协议。 我们希望这些经验教训为在可控视频生成后建立理解堆提供实际指导。

articles.title: EP-LVMQA: Evidence-Preserving Coarse-to-Fine Localization for Low-Quality Long Video Moment Question Answering
articles.content: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.

articles.title_zh: EP-LVMQA:为低质长视频动量解答问题而保存粗细到精细本地化
articles.content_zh: 在医学教育、工业培训和程序知识转让中越来越多地使用长长的教学录像,但其证据往往不完整或不可靠:字幕可能缺失、ASR吵闹、OCR稀疏,以及没有叙述的决定性行动。 现有视频 QA系统一般会返回标签或自由格式文本,使得回答支持难以检查. 我们研究了长视频瞬间问题回答(LVMQA),一个系统在其中返回有时间标记的回答支持证据. 我们提议采用EP-LVMQA,这是一个证据保全粗细框架,包括一个不确定的、有意识的多式联运证据时间表、一个粗细的证据规划员和一个有证据的精细本地化器。 一个证据卡传输计划员的分数,匹配的提示,源自信的代理,特定模式的证据,相邻上下文,以及后两个模块之间的时间前缀. 在MedVidQA上,EP-LVMQA实现26.1 R1@0.5和31.8 mIoU,使最强的非我们成绩提高了6.3和5.1分. 它将Suff.@2和Ver.@2提高到25.4和22.6,收益9.5和8.8分. 在相应的低质量扰动下,平均相对降解率从14.6%的最强非我们的值降至11.1%。 在Ego4D-NLQ和QVHighlights上,EP-LVMQA仍然大致可以与既定的任务特定本地化方法相比.

articles.title: MiCaDe: Online LiDAR-Camera Miscalibration Change Detection for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe.

articles.title_zh: 米卡德:在线LiDAR-Camera校准错误 自动驱动的更改检测
articles.content_zh: 自主车辆中可靠的多传感器感知需要在相机和LiDAR之间精确校准. 然而,在长期部署中,校准漂移往往是不可避免的:振动,热效应,和小机械冲击可能改变传感器之间的相对姿势,导致下游聚变任务发生系统性错误. 我们提议MiCaDe(Miscalibation Change Description),当外部的LiDAR-camera校准参数通过顺序变化检测方式不再准确时,在线解决方案检测. MiCaDe 不需要校准目标,或修改感官堆栈,提供低假警报率和可忽略不计的计算间接费用. 我们的关键见解是,标准物体探测器生产的3D和2D定界箱在正确校准下应保持几何一致. 通过匹配跨模式探测,我们得出了几何一致性指标,作为外向漂移的敏感指标。 这些度量衡被汇总成固定大小的批量,并对照参考分布进行打分,产生由变点模型(CPM)监测的可能性流. 关键是,CPM积累了随时间推移的统计证据,从而能够发现否则会被忽视的微妙漂移。 在多个长序列数据集和物理诱导误判的实时数据集上进行的实验,证实了在各种条件下的可靠检测. 代码见:https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MicaDe。

articles.title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 写、 不只是点头: 图像检索视图语言模型中的头
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)可以在单一上下文中处理互页文本和多个图像,但它们如何在内部识别与一个问题相关的图像仍然不甚了解. 我们研究了这个定位步骤,作为内文本图像检索,并引入ICIR-MCQ,这是用于头级图像检索分析的控制探测器. 利用每个头的注意力质量 在图像托盘的跨度, 我们首先确定 稀疏的指针头 可靠地指向目标图像。 这些头转移到探针之外:一个单指头在自然主义多图像检索基准上与外部视觉语言检索器具有竞争能力,表明LVLMs含有强大的内部图像检索信号. 然而,仅仅注意就说明一个头的读法,而不是它的输出传递到后面的几层,所以我们引入了一个互补的产出侧分析. 对于每个头,我们训练一个轻量级图像检索器,记录其价值加权输出,并利用它来识别写作头,其输出包含足够的信息,可以识别目标图像. 令人惊讶的是,指针和写作标准选择了大不相同的头集,在每个标准下,前100个头组之间只有35到47个头部重叠. 定向设定分解显示,标准多图像推论中最重要的头集中在这个指针-写手交叉处,而只有一个标准选择的头则显示与随机头控件的分离不太一致. 最一致的因果效应来自基于注意力的指针和输出侧写法标准所选择的头. 代码和数据:https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-heads.

articles.title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
articles.content: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VisSearch-Bench:评价多式联运代理商的长视野视觉搜索
articles.content_zh: 多式联运代理商使用网络和图像工具来回答超出其内部知识范围的问题. 一些搜索任务主要使用图像来识别初始实体,然后依靠文本检索. 这些任务对代理人如何在图像、物品和搜索步骤之间连接信息提供了有限的见解。 因此,我们侧重于视觉环境管理。 这涉及组织和使用视觉信息,并将其与其他搜索结果联系起来。 视觉密集的任务需要代理将对象外观,局部细节,或空间关系与外部信息相结合. 我们介绍VisSearch-Bench,它有204个人类写作的任务,涉及7个主要领域和25个子领域。 它涵盖Set-wise视觉搜索,序列视觉搜索,混合广深搜索,竞争性视觉分裂,以及视觉-结构-引导搜索. 每项任务都提供参考答案、可追踪证据和评分规则。 精确度测量完成任务成功,而过程分数测量单个结果和子问题答案的正确性和完整性. 在16个多式联运模式中,最好的系统完全解决了26.47%的任务,即使有搜索工具。 这些结果凸显了将视觉证据与搜索结果联系起来以产生完整答案的挑战.

articles.title: OCR in the Foundation Model Era: From Specialist Models to Unified Models
articles.content: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基础模型时代的OCR:从专家模型到统一模型
articles.content_zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)是人工智能最古老和部署最广泛的应用之一. 这项调查审查了其发展情况,重点是基础模型时代。 我们通过忠实的转录来定义OCR:在指定的视觉范围内,OCR应该完全重建文本,注音,以及源图像中可观测到的文档结构,输出中的每一个文字,注音,或结构元素都必须从该图像中的视觉证据中可以核实. 我们追踪从专业OCR模型向统一模型的发展,审查联合文本检测和识别,结构化序列生成,以及使用预先训练的视觉语言模型。 我们把当代的OCR系统组织成五个共存的家庭:模块化工具包和任务特定模型,专门的文件VLM,混合工作流程,通用VLM,以及商业产品和管理的服务. 我们比较他们的结构、数据和培训, 检查幻觉和遗漏, 空间定位不足, 以及遗传性OCR的推论成本。 我们审查从特征和场景文本识别到解析单个结构要素和整页抄录的评价,强调在一致的产出定义、业绩归属于单个组成部分以及涵盖真实捕捉条件和可见内容和结构方面的差距。 最后,我们总结OCR面临的挑战,并讨论未来研究的方向。 我们不断在https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era追踪相关工作。

articles.title: Trusting Imagined Futures: Auditing Imagined Rewards for VLA Post-Training
articles.content: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 试想中 期货:VLA培训后预期的回报
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型能够通过想象的结果来评价候选行动,但高预测的奖励可以有利于执行质量差的轨迹. 我们引入了 " 信任想象未来 " (TIF),这是视觉语言行动(VLA)培训后的一种离线监督选择方法,通过执行反馈对奖励进行审核。 一个多层面的奖励模式预测候选人排名的效用分数和执行质量的五个方面. 一名审计员利用奖励预测和不确定性来确定从配对的想象视频和真实处决中吸取的过高估计模式。 当候选人对现有轨迹的优势超过比值,而且其审计风险超过门槛时,TIF接受候选人的预期效用最高;否则,它保留现有的监督。 保留了真实的轨迹,然后监督行为克隆. 在四个LIBERO套房和三个培训种子中,TIF取得了76.25%的平均成功率,比现有轨迹培训提高了3.00个百分点,其轨迹计算和培训预算相同。 加上审计标值的产量1.47个百分点,奖励模式和保持的优势幅度固定不变。 优势排名和后勤回归风险选择在相应的重置计数上持续得分。 在三个真正的机器人任务录制的视频中,TIF将60个候选集合中选定轨道的清洁完成率从58.33%提高到70.0%.

articles.title: Radial distortion homography estimation from affine-covariant or orientation-covariant features
articles.content: We present minimal solvers for joint homography and radial distortion estimation using affine- or orientation-covariant features. The core contribution is a set of novel constraints that exploit local feature geometry inherent to affine descriptors, enabling solvers that require fewer correspondences than point-based methods. Using modern robust estimation frameworks, we demonstrate that the proposed solvers are advantageous to the current state-of-the-art with a significant speed-up in the presence of outliers while maintaining comparable or superior estimation accuracy. The proposed solvers are tested on both synthetic and real images containing challenging fisheye distortions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从近缘-共变或定向-共变特征对辐射扭曲图谱的估算
articles.content_zh: 我们提出最低限度的解析器,用于利用亲缘或定向的共变特征进行联合的同位素和射线扭曲估计。 核心贡献是一套新颖的制约因素,它们利用affine描述符所固有的局部特征几何,使得需要比点法更少的函证的解析器成为可能. 我们利用现代强力估计框架,表明提议的解决者对目前的先进水平是有利的,在有外部因素的情况下可以大大加快速度,同时保持可比或较高的估计准确性。 提议的解决者在合成和真实的图像上都经过测试,这些图像含有挑战性的鱼眼扭曲。

articles.title: NightIQA: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for MLLM-Based Nighttime Image Quality Assessment
articles.content: Nighttime images are inherently susceptible to complex, compound degradations, making accurate quality assessment exceptionally challenging. Score-based IQA methods condense quality into a single number, lacking the multi-dimensional, language-grounded reasoning required for nighttime evaluation. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a more comprehensive alternative, yet remain constrained by a critical data gap: existing real-world IQA datasets are overwhelmingly daytime-centric and often built from outdated captures, while synthetic alternatives lack nighttime-specific degradation modeling, yielding artifacts far removed from authentic nighttime conditions. To bridge this gap, we present NightIQA, a dataset and benchmark suite purpose-built for MLLM-based nighttime IQA. It comprises three core components: NightIQA-Real, a real-world dataset of 1,769 high-resolution images that we captured ourselves with modern equipment, encompassing six canonical distortion types and structured multi-dimensional annotations; NightIQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,078 visually grounded multiple-choice questions tailored to MLLM-based nighttime IQA, organized around a four-level evaluation hierarchy spanning Perception, Technical Assessment, Localization, and Reasoning; and NightIQA-Syn, an inherently scalable, scene-aware synthesis pipeline that jointly models global-level and instance-level degradations, with an initial release of 80k high-fidelity images alongside the full generation code. Fine-tuned on NightIQA with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms open-source IQA methods and achieves higher overall accuracy than leading closed-source models, highlighting the value of domain-specific data and structured supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NightIQA:基于MLLM的夜视图像质量评估综合数据集和基准
articles.content_zh: 夜间图像在本质上容易发生复杂的复合退化,因此准确的质量评估极具挑战性。 基于分数的IQA方法将质量压缩成一个单数,缺乏夜间评价所需的多维,基于语言的推理. 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)提供了一个更为全面的替代方案,但依然受到关键数据差距的制约:现有的现实世界的IQA数据集绝大多数以白天为中心,而且往往从过时的捕获中构建出来,而合成替代品缺乏针对夜间的降解模型,生成的文物远离真实的夜间条件. 为了弥合这一差距,我们提出了NightIQA,一个数据集和为基于MLLM的夜间IQA设计的基准套件。 它由三个核心部分组成:NightIQA-Real,一个由1,769幅高分辨率图像组成的现实世界数据集,我们用现代设备捕捉到我们自己,包括6种犬科扭曲类型和结构化多维说明;NightIQA-Bench,一个适合基于MLLM的夜间IQA的1,078个视距多选择问题的基准,它围绕一个四级评价等级组织,跨越感知、技术评估、局部化和理性;和NightIQA-Syn,一个内在可伸缩的、场景感知的合成管道,它联合模拟全球层面和实例层面的退化,与全代码一起初步发布80k高真度图像。 在"NightIQA"上进行精细调整,并配有"监督精选(SFT)"和"集团相对政策优化(GRPO)",Qun3-VL-8B超越了开源IQA方法,实现了高于领先的闭源模型的整体精度,凸显了域特有数据和结构化监督的价值.

articles.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
articles.content: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, attention has settled on one kind of intelligent individual, the embodied robot; we argue that the era of Physical AI holds a second kind of equal importance, the person augmented by AI. Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person. Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change. We give the paradigm a conceptual core, the cognitive gap between what a person could bring to a situation and what they can hold in working memory, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop of sensing, keeping, understanding, living alongside, acting for and thinking with the person, and growing, enclosed by a personal runtime and by trust. Because a symbiont changes what a person can do in front of others, it also raises risks of a new kind, from covert assistance in examinations to pressure on everyone to adopt it, and we treat their governance as part of the paradigm.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从自主代理到认知符号:走向人工智能
articles.content_zh: 10年来,人工智能的进步是通过机器自己能做的多少来衡量的. 大型基础模型现在编写代码并运行多步任务,个人特工代表个人行事. 然而人们仍然忘记了自己曾经知道的事情,错过了自己不看的东西,没有找到正确的词句,在没有自身历史利益的情况下面对艰难的选择,因为能够帮助摆脱困境的机器. 当AI进入物理世界时,注意力已经固定在一种智能个体上,即被体现的机器人上;我们主张,物理AI的时代具有第二种同等的重要性,即由AI所增强的人. 人工一般智能(人工智能)询问机器的智能程度如何,与此同时,人工智能(人工智能)是人工智能强化的人类智能(人工智能),人工智能询问机器在特定人身上能够提供多少智能. 认识它需要一种新型的系统,一种认知的共鸣:一种终生的,嵌入的,实时的,私人的,低调的,以及主动的伴奏,这些伴奏能够感知人通过外部设备感受到的东西,保持他们多年的上下文,模拟他们的处境和思想,在正确的时刻参与他们的思考,用他们的背景来完成日常的任务,并且不断学习人作为两者的改变. 我们赋予这个范式一个概念核心, 一个人能给一个情况带来的东西和他们在工作记忆中能持有的东西之间的认知差距, 并组织它的设计空间,作为感知的共生循环, 保持,理解, 与人并肩生活, 为人做和思考, 并成长, 被个人的运行时间和信任所包围。 因为一个共鸣会改变一个人在别人面前能够做的事情,它也带来了一种新的风险,从在考试中暗中协助,到向每个人施压以采纳,我们把他们的治理作为范式的一部分.

articles.title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
articles.content: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 将语言模型与普惠制对齐:直接纳什优化的经验研究
articles.content_zh: Direct Nash Optimation(DNO)通过近似双玩家偏好游戏的Nash均衡来将语言模型与一般偏好功能相配合. 其实用变体DNO-Prct,迭代政策采样,LLM对样本的评分加上教师的黄金应答,大边角偏好派选择和DPO风格的对比性更新. 我们独立地重新执行DNO-Prct,并用两个开放量级指示模型来研究它,Llama 3.1 8B Instruct和Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1,使用GPT-4o或者一个更大的开放量级模型,与注释器相同. 在以GPT-4o为评委的AlpacaEval 2.0上,三次迭代将长控(LC)对格PT-4o的胜率由拉玛的31.7%提升至45.3%,对米斯特拉尔的胜率由6.8%提升至18.4%,调制8B模型得分高于拉玛3.1 70B对每一次报道的胜率进行指示. 与同家族开放量级的注释员,运行保留了以GPT-4o作为注释员实现的LC增益的62%(Llama)和82%(Mistral),因此评级步骤不需要专有模式. 在单独的减速配置中,去除金应答,去掉数据回看的变体,或者只接受老师偏爱的对子在全程序下得分6至10LC,而改变每快(1至7)的政策样本数量将LC的胜率移动最多2.1分,在自己的输油管中进行比值扫描(1至5)最多2.4分. 我们还报告输油管的费用以及实际算法偏离其理论之处。 所有结果都是单行的,GPT-4o既是老师又是评审法官;我们讨论这对所报告的收益意味着什么.

articles.title: Suppressing Misaligned Behaviors in Language Models, Durably
articles.content: Undesired model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge at any stage of training. Once observed, how effectively can we suppress them? To study this question, we first construct two model organisms--language models deliberately trained to exhibit a specific misalignment--that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism misbehaves only when the prompt contains a specific cue: it cheats on multiple-choice questions by following a planted hint that points to a wrong answer, and behaves normally otherwise. The broad-trigger organism has no such cue: after fine-tuning on insecure code, it gives harmful responses across a wide range of open-ended prompts. We then formalize post-hoc behavioral suppression and evaluate methods along three criteria: immediate suppression of the target behavior, durability under further training, and preservation of general capability. We compare standard methods--SFT, GRPO, and gradient-ascent unlearning--along these dimensions. Building on prior work on alignment shallowness, we hypothesize that more durable suppression requires the ability to recover from a wider range of misalignment states. We introduce Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (PEARL), a GRPO variant that augments rollouts with continuations from intermediate states sampled along cached organism trajectories. Across both organism settings and two model families (Qwen3-4B, GPT-OSS-20B), PEARL achieves strong immediate suppression while preserving task accuracy, and remains durable under further fine-tuning on either the organism's data or unrelated data. It obtains the greatest benefit when the undesirable behavior is broad and cannot be addressed through targeted SFT. Together, our framework and method offer a step toward more durable post-hoc removal of undesired behaviors.

articles.title_zh: 禁止语言模型中的错配行为, 不可容忍
articles.content_zh: 不受欢迎的模型行为可以在任何训练阶段出现或重新出现. 一旦观察到,我们如何能够有效地压制它们? 为了研究这个问题,我们首先构建了两种模式的生物语言模型 专门训练来显示一种特定的错位—— 这在引发行为的原因上是不同的。 狭小的触发机体只有在提示包含一个特定提示时才会出现行为不端:它通过遵循指向错误答案的植入提示在多个选择问题上作弊,并且行为正常. 广义的触发机体没有这样的提示:在微调了不安全的代码后,它在广泛的无限制的提示中给出了有害的反应. 然后,我们按照三个标准正式确定行为后抑制和评价方法:立即制止目标行为、在进一步训练下保持耐久性和保持一般能力。 我们比较了标准方法 -- -- SFT、GRPO和梯度上升而不学习 -- -- 这些层面。 在先前关于调整浅度的工作基础上,我们假设,更持久的抑制需要从更广泛的错位状态中恢复的能力。 我们引入了前缀-扩展强化学习(PEARL),这是一种GPRO的变体,它通过从中间状态沿缓存生物轨迹取样的续作来扩大推广。 在整个机体设置和两个模型家族(Quen3-4B,GPT-OSS-20B)中,PEARL在保持任务精确性的同时,实现了强烈的即时压制,并在机体数据或无关数据的进一步微调下保持耐用性. 当不良行为广泛且无法通过有针对性的SFT加以解决时,它便获得最大的利益。 我们的框架和方法共同为更持久地消除不良行为提供了一个步骤。

articles.title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
articles.content: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look more like the words annotators highlighted, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers on two short test pairs and kept or changed them under deletion as the model does; the evidence itself did not yet survive the device, and we work out the shots and calibration that measuring it on hardware would need.

articles.title_zh: 阅读为什么:天生的 - 测量的注意 与精确的文字证据 关于光和Qubits
articles.content_zh: 当一个语言模型回答时,我们通常只能估计原因. 我们建造一个变压器,其中每个步骤都是天生的测量——注意每行正常的$|\langle q|k\rangle 4$,一个测量的产品代替饲料前向的非线性,以及天生的读数。 其分母为输入值,每个类概率都是振幅词中的一种多元性,所以其综合渐变的证据是由一个没有四分法的有限四分法计算出来的:词对类概率的贡献总和高于其无信息份额,达到10^{-11}美元或更高. 在e-SNLI自然语言推论中,嵌入体外有约98k参数,该模型达到76.98\pm 0.17 %测试精度,水平与大小相同的软马克斯变压器(76.62\pm 0.36 %). 删除该词时,其证据排位会首先改变45%的测试对的答案,在53%的任何单一删除都可以改变,而软马克斯模型的32%的答案是相同的,40%的答案是注意x梯度。 注意可以看起来更像强调的注释者,然而说明答案不太好:删除它排列的词首先会改变"天生变形器"在32%的对中给出的答案. 同样的权重完全编译为光电子光学和qubit,一个连贯的注意力层成为一个与模型等效的电路(23qubit上的852 CNOTs). 在IBM的ibm_kingston上,只读到哈达默德测试的注意力重叠,设备在两个短测试对上给出了模型的答案,并像模型一样将其保留或修改在删除中;证据本身还没有在设备中存活下来,我们研究出在硬件上测量它所需要的镜头和校准.

articles.title: A Circuit for In-Context Learning
articles.content: In-context learning (ICL) lets a pretrained language model perform a task specified by demonstrations in its prompt, with no parameter updates. With arbitrary labels the model must acquire a mapping it cannot have memorized, so the learning happens within a single forward pass. Prior work found candidate parts but not how they compose. We give the composition for few-shot sentence classification with arbitrary labels in three 3-4B-parameter transformers. The model implements a key-value memory over label-token positions: each label token's residual stream encodes the label's identity, and middle-layer attention heads write into it the class of the preceding demonstration as its key. At the query, upper-layer heads match the query's class against the stored keys and copy out the matching labels. An early-layer signal encoding whether any label has repeated gates this readout; in its absence the readers attend to the start of the prompt and no label is favored. A separate set of heads suppresses the most recently seen label. Each step is established causally by activation patching, head ablations against random-head baselines, and steering with the model's own signals. A softmax model of the readout with two constants per head, fit on one prompt distribution, predicts another. The computation is conserved across the three models, the named heads alone reproduce the behaviour, and a transformer trained from scratch grows the same parts. The circuit transfers to semantic concepts and to labels with meaning, and the same parts, with a causal gate, appear from 0.6B to 8B in one family and survive instruction tuning. ICL in this setting is a gated associative lookup built from a few identifiable component types, traced causally from demonstrations to prediction.

articles.title_zh: 内文学习的电路
articles.content_zh: in-context学习(ICL)让一个预先训练的语言模型在它的即时执行演示指定的任务,没有参数更新. 有了任意的标签,模型必须获得一个它无法记住的映射,所以学习发生在一个单一的前传中. 先前的工作找到了候选部分,但没有找到其构成方式。 我们给出了几发的句子的成分分类,在三个3-4B参数变压器中带有任意的标签. 该模型在标签脚本位置上执行一个键值内存:每个标签符的剩余流编码标签的身份,中层关注头将上一个演示的类写入其中,作为它的关键. 在查询时,上层头像与存储的密钥对应查询类,并复制匹配的标签. 早期的信号编码, 以定义任何标签是否重复了此读出闸门; 在它不存在的情况下, 阅读器会注意提示的开始, 没有标签 。 一套单独的头来压制最近看到的标签. 每一步都通过激活补丁,头部与随机头基线相对应,并用模型本身的信号向导来因果确定. 一个读取的软马克斯模型,每头有两个常数,适合一个即时分布,预测另一个. 计算被保存在三个模型中,被命名的头单独复制行为,一个从零开始训练的变压器会生长相同的部分. 电路向语义概念和带有意义的标签转移,具有因果门的相同部分在一个家族中从0.6B到8B出现,幸存指令调谐. 在这个背景下的ICL是一个由几个可识别的组件类型所构建的门式的关联性搜索,从演示到预测都有因果追溯.

articles.title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
articles.content: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.

articles.title_zh: 医疗 Phys Bench: 医学物理计算和错误检测语言模型评价基准
articles.content_zh: 医学物理学家将处方转化为送药剂量,并检查对方的计算结果,因为光束校准或监视器-单元(MU)计算中的一个错误会影响到用它治疗的每一个病人. MedPhys Bench在辐射治疗,诊断成像,核医学和辐射防护方面有10个计算项目的种子发电机,最多可完成TG-51校准工作表等临床任务. 引用答案来自执行规范协议的代码,一个分级器转换单位并应用容限带. 在同一输入中,单独检查项目测试错误检测,显示同事的工作表或只显示同事的结果,一半正确,一半有植入错误. 在1,200项(两个模型的一半)的搁置试验中,12项模型在计算上得分33.3%至100.0%。 在9个对4个最佳(99.3%-100.0%)的回答中,有5个有模型错误,4个则遵循了NCRP Report 151,关于我们的项目错误陈述或未打开的点。 在他们下面,大多数模型在三级临床任务上表现最差,克劳德·索内特5.5在20个异心MU项目中的19个项目中省略了逆方修正. 5个模型检测到至少96.7%的多数大面积植入误差,最多有4%的假警报;其他7个模型中,有4个模型只检查结果就明显产生假警报. 在一次探索性定向测试中,有20个公案遗漏了反平面校正,在每张工作单中都发现了3个最佳模型,3个较弱的模型接受了20张植入工作单中的16至18张,其中1张同时在大多数自己的计算中应用校正. 克劳德·奥普斯5.5接受了20个错误结果中的6个,尽管它自己全部20个都应用了这个更正. 我们报告在运行后发现的屏蔽物品中两个问题的影响,并发布代码、每个项目结果和有针对性的测试反应。

articles.title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
articles.content: Skill memories encode past experiences as textual prompts to improve reinforcement learning (RL) for self-evolving agents. Complementing RL, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) provides dense, fine-grained supervision to internalize knowledge from skill-guided trajectories and accelerate policy learning. However, self-generated memories often contain noisy supervision and functionally entangled, redundant, or conflicting knowledge, making direct distillation difficult. Under limited training budgets, these issues can hinder knowledge internalization and even degrade performance. To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization. MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches. OPSD then transfers and consolidates complementary experiential knowledge across these branches into a shared policy, enabling efficient skill internalization and continuous agent self-evolution. We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models. Without additional computational overhead, MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop. Extensive ablations and evolution analyses further validate its effectiveness in knowledge internalization and policy improvement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDSKILL-CF53.

articles.title_zh: MDSKILL: 学习通过多维分化将技能内存内化, 用于高效动态代理自演
articles.content_zh: 技能记忆将过去的经验编码为文字提示,用于改进自我进化剂的强化学习(RL). 补充RL,On-Political Self-dispiration(OPSD)提供密集的,精细的监管,从技能指导的轨迹将知识内化,加速政策学习. 然而,自我生成的记忆中往往包含吵闹的监管和功能缠绕,冗余,或相互冲突的知识,使得直接蒸馏变得困难. 在有限的培训预算下,这些问题可能妨碍知识内部化,甚至降低业绩。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出MDSKILLL,一种技能内存内化的多视角蒸馏方法. MDSKILL将技能记忆组织成三个互补的功能视图(状态定位,动作规划和执行控制),并使用动态度量法来选择高质量的技能来构建特定视图和综合推理分支. OPSD然后将这些分支的互补经验知识转移和整合为共同政策,使有效的技能内部化和持续的代理自我演化成为可能. 我们对MDSKILL进行对照RL的三项代理基准评价,这些基准是技能强化的,以及不依赖更强大的外部教师模式的自我消化基线。 在不增加计算间接费用的情况下,MDSKILL在SOTA性能上提高7.1%,在ALFWorld和WebShop上提高8.1%. 广泛的演化和演变分析进一步验证其在知识内化和政策改进方面的效力。 该代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDSKILL-CF53上查阅.

articles.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
articles.content: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

articles.title_zh: 循环VQ: 循环变换器的子 1 位 KV 快取量
articles.content_zh: 循环变压器是标准变压器的一种参数高效的替代品,用于语言建模. 通过跨多个循环步骤重新应用同一层,最近循环的语言模型与非螺旋模型的性能相匹配了几倍大小. 虽然这个架构有效地减少了参数内存,但是每个循环步骤仍然存储着自己的密钥和值,因此密钥值(KV)缓存随循环步骤的数量而呈线性增长,成为主要的内存瓶颈. 我们观测到,循环模型的KV缓存在循环轴上是高度冗余的,循环步骤在对量化的敏感度上差别很大. 基于这些观察,我们提出 $\textbf{LoopVQ}$,一种KV缓存向量量化方法,用于循环变速器,该变速器将多个循环步骤的通道联合编码,并微调编码本,以匹配全精度模型的输出. 以每元素0.5比特,LoopVQ在一般,长链思维推理,与Ouo和Huginn模型的长链检索任务上超越了现有的标准LLMS的KV缓存向量定量方法. 它的设计与这些方法是正交的,结合TaSQ,它保留了大部分BF16精度,即使每个元素0.25比特. 我们还在SGLang实施LoopVQ,在32K位上下文中,它几乎将解码间隔减半,并将最高服务吞吐量提高4.3美元,1.4B和2.6B上6.1美元。 Ouro模型与BF16基线相比.

articles.title: Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute
articles.content: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.

articles.title_zh: 人不是人:身份为国家,非属性
articles.content_zh: 合成人群,大型的模拟人群,被越来越多地用于代替真人进行预测试调查,模拟用户和社区,并评价AI系统. 每个模拟人由一个人物a,一个固定特征的书面剖面,人口学,以及语言模型指示采取行动的态度来定义. 每一个这样的系统都假设一个人的身份是稳定的属性,在模拟呈现的每一个情况中行为都一样. 我们表明,这种假设并非是无害的简化。 三十年的人格研究发现与此相反. 一个人的行为方式因背景而异,而人则因人而异。 借鉴身份经济学,描述不同情况如何激活同一人内部的不同身份和规范,我们把行为分为三个部分,这三个部分是稳定的特征,一个上下文唤起的身份,以及情况本身. 然后,我们根据两个陈述的假设证明,任何建立在固定人身上的模拟,无论人有多详细,或基本模型有多大,都不能复制人口行为中与它及其具体情况具体相关的部分。 我们根据这一结果提出了一个新的评价标准,并提出了可以原则上满足其要求的实际设计。 我们测试一个关于自然主义的Reddit人格保护书的版本,并测试对一个对医疗机构有文件记载的不信任的社区进行公开的临床审判性招聘调查。 设计在直接测试时确实会产生上下文依赖的行为,但在两个设定中都没有完全匹配真实的人群,我们显示其不足之处. 做法的后果是,合成人口评价有可能歪曲其行为最受背景影响的群体,这种扭曲是较富人无法纠正的。

articles.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
articles.content: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.

articles.title_zh: 明知错误:针对自身信仰的培训法学硕士可能引发错位
articles.content_zh: 微调狭义领域有害数据的大型语言模型(LLM),如不良医疗建议,可能使其大致错位. 这一风险是否现实尚不清楚,因为模型在实践中很少对明显有害的数据进行微调。 在这部作品中,我们显示,对模型认为不实的数据进行微调,但没有有害的内容,也会引起广泛的错位. 在整个数学,三维,烹饪和运动中,模型越强烈地不相信它所训练的答案,就越错位. 在数学中,错误的答案从4%上升至60%以上,因为培训答案变得更加错误,一般能力几乎没有丧失。 在微调后,模型给出了错误的答案,但其多选择概率仍然偏爱真实的答案,这表明错位来自这种内部不一致. 然后,我们研究一种更现实的环境,即更新一个单一的事实,如知识编辑或持续学习。 同样的关系维持了下来,模型在接受假的训练后仍然越相信真实的事实,就越是错位. 当我们把同一个假事实编成一个连贯的故事的一部分时,模型开始更深刻地相信它,并且变得不像我们指示它断言这个假事实时那样错位. 内容过滤器和人称矢量无法区分这两个框架,即使它们导致不同层次的错配. 这些结果表明,模型更新存在风险,培训一个不采用新事实的模型,即使数据看起来无害,也会引起错配。

articles.title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
articles.content: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. For the third, we evaluate several intervention configurations on Qwen2.5-7B, by varying subspace creation methods and intervention operators. We find that the intervention that most improves MGSM accuracy sacrifices response-language fidelity, with only one intervention improving joint accuracy--answers that are correct and in the target language--slightly, by 1.60 points. Interestingly, subtle changes in the prompt alone can reproduce the accuracy gains albeit with significant damage to language fidelity. We argue that causal interventions must be judged on more than accuracy, to fully account for language substitution trade-offs.

articles.title_zh: 超越精确度:什么语言-子空间干预 抓取、删除和改进
articles.content_zh: 语言子空间干预旨在通过压制中层激活中与语言相关的组件来改进多语种推理. 使用MATH和MGSM跨越四个开放量的LLM,我们提出三个问题:估计语言子空间是否捕捉翻译相关变异? 投影是否删除语言信息 ? 它们是否提高准确性而不损害反应语言? 第一个问题,我们利用现有的Mean-SVD构建和我们的DiffPCA构建子空间. 两者都捕捉到与翻译相关的大量变异,并显示跨模型深度的类似模式. 第二,我们预测每个子空间,并训练线性探测器,以便从预测的激活中将语言分类。 探测器仍然几乎完美地识别语言,表明两个子空间都没有穷尽地捕捉语言信息. 第三,我们通过不同的子空间创建方法和干预操作员,对Quen2.5-7B上的几个干预配置进行评估. 我们发现,大多数提高MGSM精度的干预会牺牲响应语言的忠实性,只有一次干预可以改善联合精度的答案,这些答案是正确的,在目标语言中略微提高1.60分. 有趣的是,光是迅速的微妙变化就可以复制精度的提高,尽管对语言的忠诚性有重大损害。 我们主张,必须不仅仅根据准确性来判断因果干预,以充分顾及语言替代的权衡。

articles.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
articles.content: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.

articles.title_zh: ARLOOP:全开预训带注意力的循环变换器
articles.content_zh: 环绕式变压器通过反复应用一组共享的变压器层来提高有效深度,提供了一个参数高效的计算方法. 然而,标准残余连接将跨经常性深度的信息汇总到单一流中,对前几层的中间表述应当重新使用的控制有限。 在本文中,我们引入了ARLoop,一种基于注意力残留的环绕式变压器架构,其中每个层的输入通过注意力在模型深度上选择性地聚合. 与标准变压器不同,我们发现环绕变压器不需要访问完整的剩余历史:滑动-窗口深度注意力匹配或者在更大的重复深度中超越了全历史注意力. 纵观多参数尺度(140M和370M)和重复深度(R=1至5)的受控实验,ARLoop在环绕变压器的先前剩余设计上一直表现优于. 更重要的是,我们在现实的LLM预训配方下,进一步将ARLoop的参数扩大至0.6B和1.2B,表明收益转移至现实的预训,在数学和编码任务方面有特别强的改进. 我们的1.2B模型,只预先训练了0.5T令牌,有三次重现,超过Huginn-3.5B(截至我们发布之日唯一完全开放的LLM),在所有评估任务上,尽管接受的数据少得多的培训,却与类似大小的非Lood模型,如Qune3.5-2B,具有竞争力.

articles.title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.

articles.title_zh: 模特儿看见什么了? 基于LLM的多式联运视频分析中的代表性有效性
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)允许社会科学家对视频进行规模分析,但研究人员必须决定视频的哪些部分作为输入提供. 我们使用表达有效性这一术语来审查文本、音频、视频和综合投入如何影响衡量和随后的分析。 我们比较了6个开放重量的MLLM和3个人类附加说明的视频数据集的输入表示. 没有代表的表现一贯最好。 在7个与新闻有关的构件中,各模型(macro-F1=.70-.77)的本地-视频性能差异不大,而提取的文本性能则从.52到.80不等. 三个模型在文本上表现较好,三个则在视频上表现较好. 综合投入很少能改善业绩。 更准确的分类也无法可靠地得出更接近基于人类代码的估计数。 在42个比较中的17个比较中,最高的F1代表最能复制人类编码的回归系数. 即使每个模型使用其最高的F1可部署代表,45%的样本流行率估计数与人编码基准不同,超过10个百分点。 因此,输入表示法要求验证所测量的构造和由此产生的标签估计的数量。

articles.title: When Self-Verification Hurts: Calibrated Answer Repair for Financial Question Answering
articles.content: Financial question answering can fail even when a model extracts a plausible number from the supplied evidence: the answer may attach it to the wrong entity, period, unit, or accounting concept. Asking the model to verify and revise its draft can help, but open-ended revision may alter content that was already correct or inspect the wrong relation and reinforce the original error. We formulate repair as a decision that balances the information it may recover against the correct content it may damage. Based on this trade-off, we introduce Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR), which first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from repair, then selects a targeted check, localizes the relevant evidence or draft span, and limits the permitted edit. Across FinRank, Fin-RATE, and FinQA with three open-weight models, CAR outperforms generic verification in all dataset-model settings. At the system level, it recovers 14.6% of initially missed answer requirements while damaging 2.1% of initially correct ones. Its post-draft token cost is over 30 percent lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Ablations on two dataset-model settings show that evidence localization and bounded editing are the main contributors to CAR's gains.

articles.title_zh: 自我验证伤害:财务问题答案校准
articles.content_zh: 即使一个模型从提供的证据中提取出一个可信的数字,财务问题答案也可能失败:答案可能附在错误的实体、时期、单位或会计概念上。 要求模型核实和修改其草案会有所帮助,但开放式修改可能会改变已经正确或检查错误关系的内容,强化原来的错误. 我们制定修复办法是为了在它可能恢复的信息与它可能损坏的正确内容之间保持平衡。 基于这种权衡,我们引入了校准解答修补(CAR),它首先估计草稿是否可能从修理中受益,然后选择有针对性的检查,确定相关证据或草稿的长度,并限制允许的编辑。 通过FinRank、Fin-RATE和FinQA三种开放重量型号,CAR在所有数据集模型设置中都超过了通用验证。 在系统层面,它回收了14.6%最初错过的答案要求,同时损坏了2.1%最初正确的答案要求. 它的草稿后代币成本比迭代修订方案低30%以上. 在两个数据集模型设置上的偏差表明,证据本地化和定界编辑是CAR收益的主要贡献者.

articles.title: GM League Arena: An Interactive Long-Horizon Task Benchmark Based on Professional Sports League Management
articles.content: Long-horizon decision-making under sustained competition requires large language models (LLMs) to balance immediate investment with future resource needs. However, local success in multi-step interactions can not adequately capture cumulative decision effects or demonstrate long-term goal achievement under resource constraints and sustained competition. To address this gap, we introduce GM Bench, a benchmark for managing professional sports teams across seasons under resource constraints and competition among teams. We build the environment simulators for four sports and add financial constraints, player demands, and market mechanisms to establish a unified task across sports. Diverse rosters of comparable strength are constructed from real-world player data, and each LLM is evaluated as a team general manager to assess its long-term management capabilities. We evaluate competitive performance, cash reserves, and cross-season improvement across four sports. Over five NBA seasons, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first among 29 LLMs, while GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine strong performance with larger cash reserves.

articles.title_zh: 全球机制 联盟竞技场:交互式长视野 基于职业体育联盟管理的任务基准
articles.content_zh: 持续竞争下的长范围决策需要大型语言模型来平衡眼前的投资和未来的资源需求。 然而,当地在多步骤互动中的成功不能充分反映累积决策效果,也不能显示在资源限制和持续竞争下实现长期目标的情况。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了GM Beach,这是在资源限制和团队竞争下管理各赛季专业体育队的基准。 我们为四大体育建设环境模拟器,并增加财政约束,玩家需求,市场机制,建立贯穿体育的统一任务. 具有可比实力的不同名册是根据现实世界的玩家数据构建的,每个LM都作为团队总经理进行评价,以评估其长期管理能力. 我们评价竞争表现,现金储备,以及四个体育项目的跨季改进。 超过5个NBA赛季,克劳德·奥普斯5.5在29个LLM赛季中排名第一,而GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol则将强劲的表现与更大的现金储备相结合.

articles.title: The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
articles.content: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.
