articles.title_zh: " 右源不充足:理解发言中的历史干扰 " 。 内存
articles.content_zh: 语音大语言模型保留音频历史以支持多回合对话. 然而,记住某一事件并不能确保其信息只在相关时才使用。 我们调查的是,为什么即使在被询问的事件仍然有代表的情况下,历史音频也发生了无关紧要的变化。 对MOSS-Audio和MiMo-Audio进行控制的实验表明,历史价值将错误引向特定的相互竞争的答案,超出了上下文长度的一般效果。 因果关系干预区分了两种途径。 在无限制的问题回答中,大多数历史值错误在之后的计算无法直接访问不相关的源时消失. 在多选择的回答中,许多错误仍然存在:早期的历史影响被质疑的状态所承载,即使在直接源访问被阻断之后. 低维干预进一步将源作用信息与答案值信息区分开来. 它们的效果在不同深度达到峰值,改变源作用信号并不能消除竞争价值的因果关系. 在自然发生的错误方面,加强被询问的角色和抵消历史价值会改进答案;他们的联合干预提供了最大的恢复。 这些结论支持在来源识别之外未能使用下游证据:源的作用信息可以影响决定,而不能完全控制影响它的历史价值。 因此,可靠的对话内存不仅需要保留和检索,还需要控制保留的信息如何进入答案计算。

articles.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.content: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.

articles.title_zh: 工具空间:长视线代理工具-科学环境综合
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型作为长视距代理被部署,将跨MCP服务的各种工具编成可执行的工作流程. 现有的MCP环境尺度方法以数据为中心:它们首先合成一个数据库和情景,然后从中获取工具和任务. 因此,工具接口可能不匹配真实的接口,工具构成不基于执行,任务很少跨越一个以上的环境. 我们提出"工具空间",一个以工具为中心的框架来扭转这个顺序. ToolSpace矿井数据、状态和重试来自相邻电话的依赖性,使用确定性规则而不是LLM判断,在真实的MCP服务和开源代理公司的执行痕迹中将由此产生的加权工具组合图组合到环境中。 数据库只针对状态变换环境进行合成,而查询和无国籍工具则重放记录的返回. ToolSpace然后以回滚方式进行状态意识随机行走,将每个链条分解为自然语言任务,并进行基于断言的检查,只保留从初始状态中成功重播的样本. 该管道适用于自动化奔驰和Tau3-奔驰银行业务,生产更硬的Pro版本,7个前沿型号下降最多38.2点. 在7个长视距工具使用基准中,TollectSpace将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从23.0提高到41.0平均分(43.2与RL),GLM-5.2从44.6提高到56.6,与Claude Opus 5. 差距表明,被处决的目击证人的优势明显高于LLM判断的优势,而且随着数据和环境尺度的扩大,性能不断提高。

articles.title: Whose Effect Is It? How Objectives Inflate Learned Subspace Interventions
articles.content: Interpretability often locates concepts by copying part of a language model's state from one input into another (activation patching). A larger output change counts as stronger evidence that this part carries the concept. Methods that learn which part to copy often change the output more than the whole state does. By that reading, learned parts isolate the concept more cleanly. Yet the whole contains the part. So whose effect is this excess, the network's or the method's? Copying the whole state learns nothing, so it shows what the network produces. We prove that, to first order, the effects of orthogonal parts add up to that of the whole. A part therefore exceeds the whole exactly when the rest moves the output back, which does not require isolating the concept more cleanly. Objectives that reward a larger effect select such parts. Distributed alignment search with cross-entropy, for example, exceeds the whole-state copy just before the output on almost all tasks, and inside the network at most sites. In both, changing only its objective to target what the network produces removes most of the excess. It therefore comes largely from the objective, so a larger learned effect alone is not stronger evidence.

articles.title_zh: 是谁的影响? 如何扩大已学到的次空间干预
articles.content_zh: 可解释性通常通过将语言模型的部分状态从一个输入复制到另一个输入(激活补丁)来定位概念. 更大的产出变化可以更有力地证明这一部分带有这一概念。 学习哪一部分复制的方法往往比整个状态更能改变输出. 通过这种解读,学习的部分将概念更清晰地隔离. 然而,整个过程包含了这个部分。 那么这个多余的,网络的还是方法的? 复制全州学无所学,故能显示网络的产物. 我们证明,首先,正交部分的作用与整体的作用相加。 因此,当其余部分将输出向后移动时,某一部分就超过了整个部分,这不需要更明确地孤立概念。 奖励更大效果的目标选择这些部分。 例如,分布式对齐搜索与跨内线,在几乎所有任务输出前就超过了全状态副本,在大多数站点的网络内部. 在两者中,只改变其目标,即瞄准网络产生的东西,就可以消除大部分的过剩. 因此,这主要来自目标,因此,仅仅一个更大的知识效应并不是更强有力的证据。

articles.title: Who is the Pronoun Pro? Comparing LLMs and Humans at Number-Disambiguation of 'they'
articles.content: This study evaluates whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably replace or complement human research assistants in linguistically complex annotation. In a controlled annotation task, 73 human annotators (local students and crowdworkers with and without a background in linguistics) and more than 40 LLM configurations number-disambiguated 174 authentic uses of 'they' from Reddit, including innovative and context-sensitive cases. The best LLM, Kimi K3, reached 94.5% accuracy, above the human majority vote (86.2%) and the mean of the top half of human annotators (78.5%); only the single best human annotator scored higher (95.7%). LLMs also offer substantial practical advantages in cost and speed. However, qualitative error analysis reveals a crucial complementarity: human reasoning in low-agreement cases exposes inconsistencies in the annotation typology and thereby improves the methodological framework itself. The study contributes (i) a benchmark-style human-LLM comparison for a semantically demanding task, (ii) transparent cost and time evidence, and (iii) a methodological argument against a purely replacement-oriented view of automation. LLMs are viable for large-scale annotation support in linguistics, but their responsible use requires human critical oversight. The dataset with its gold-standard labels, all human and LLM annotations, and the fully reproducible code are openly available as a Quarto-based, public repository.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 谁是代言人Pro? 比较LLMs和人类在数字化 区分“他们”
articles.content_zh: 本研究评价大型语言模型(LLMs)是否能够可靠地取代或补充语言复杂注解中的人类研究助手. 在受控的注解任务中,73名人文注解员(当地学生和有语言学背景和没有语言学背景的人群工作者)和40多个LLM配置,对来自Reddit的"他们"的174个真实用途进行了区别,包括创新和对背景敏感的案例. 最佳LLM,Kimi K3的精度达到94.5%,高于人类多数的选票(86.2%)和人类前半部分的平均值(78.5%);只有单一的人类最佳注释者得分较高(95.7%). 法学硕士课程在成本和速度方面也提供了实质性的实际优势。 然而,定性错误分析揭示了一种至关重要的互补性:低协议案件中的人类推理暴露了注释类型中的不一致之处,从而改进了方法框架本身。 该研究有助于(一) 以基准为主的人类-LLM比较一项艰巨的任务,(二) 透明的成本和时间证据,(三) 反对纯粹面向替换的自动化观点的方法论论点。 LLMS在语言学中可以进行大规模注解支持,但其负责任的使用需要人批判监督. 带有其黄金标准标签的数据集,所有的人文和LLM说明,以及完全可复制的代码作为Quarto的公开寄存器公开提供.

articles.title: Shuffled OPSD: When Semantic Consistency Hurts On-Policy Self-Distillation?
articles.content: Knowledge distillation improves a student model's reasoning ability through supervision from a teacher. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the same model as both teacher and student under different contexts: the student generates reasoning trajectories from the question alone, while the teacher additionally receives a complete worked example and provides token-level supervision along those trajectories. Because the problem statement is shared, its content and ordering shape both student generation and teacher feedback. Preserving its semantic structure therefore seems natural, but does it always improve learning? We introduce Shuffled OPSD, which shuffles the words of the shared problem statement while keeping the teacher-only worked example intact. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 model scales, the method improves mean accuracy over both an intact-target control and Standard OPSD under matched training configurations. The largest gain over Standard OPSD is 3.52 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B. Further controls show that preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling at the evaluated scales, whereas shuffling the teacher-only worked example reduces accuracy at every scale. Cross-problem mixing and target-removal experiments further distinguish the roles of problem content, word order, and teacher context. These results show that disrupting the shared problem statement can improve learning, while disrupting the teacher-only reference hurts performance. They challenge semantic coherence as a universally beneficial principle for OPSD and motivate closer study of how input structure shapes student generation and teacher supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Shuffled OPSD:当语义一致性伤害到政策上的自我扭曲时?
articles.content_zh: 知识蒸馏通过教师的监督提高了学生模型的推理能力. 政策上的自我消化(OPSD)在不同的背景下使用与师生相同的模式:学生仅从问题中生成推理轨迹,而教师则额外接收一个完整的工作实例,并沿着这些轨迹提供象征性层面的监督. 由于问题陈述是共享的,其内容和顺序既塑造了学生的产生,也塑造了教师的反馈. 因此,保留其语义结构似乎是自然的,但它是否总是改善学习? 我们介绍Shuffled OPSD,它洗刷了共享问题陈述的词句,同时保留了只用老师操作的榜样不变. 在三个数学推理基准和三个Qwen3模型尺度中,该方法在匹配的培训配置下,提高了完整目标控制和标准OPSD的精度。 比标准OPSD收益最大的是Quen3–1.7B的3.52个百分点. 进一步的控制措施表明,保留较大的字块对评价尺度的字级打字没有好处,而只用教师操作的例子打字会降低每个尺度的准确性。 交叉问题混合和目标清除实验进一步区分了问题内容,词序,和教师背景的作用. 这些结果表明,破坏共同问题陈述可以改善学习,而破坏只供教师参考则会损害绩效. 它们将语义一致性作为OPSD的一项普遍有益的原则提出挑战,并激励对输入结构如何塑造学生的产生和教师的监督进行更密切的研究。

articles.title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
articles.content: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora. To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora. This approach substantially expands the training dataset, mitigating both data scarcity and temporal overfitting across different historical periods. Extensive automated and human evaluations demonstrate that HERIT consistently outperforms baselines. Finally, we translate previously untranslated portions of the archives using our model, thereby enabling global access to these resources for researchers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HERIT:让全球能够使用Hanja对英语的历史翻译,
articles.content_zh: 历史档案对于多学科研究来说是宝贵的,但由于语言障碍严重,在全球仍然无法查阅。 虽然人工翻译费用高昂而且费时,但仅仅应用现有的机器翻译模型是不够的,因为语言上有独特的细微差别,而且稀有的人类标本公司内在的时间偏差。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议使用HERIT这一系统化的域适应管道,利用回收加固的生成(RAG),从丰富的Hanja-韩氏体生成高质量的伪标签数据。 这种方法大大扩展了培训数据集,缓解了不同历史时期的数据稀缺和时间过渡。 广泛的自动化和人文评价表明,HERIT的业绩一贯高于基线。 最后,我们使用我们的模型翻译以前未翻译的部分档案,从而使研究人员能够在全球范围内利用这些资源。

articles.title: Residual Attribute Leakage Is an Interface: Auditing Privacy Evaluation After Text De-identification
articles.content: A privacy evaluation of de-identified text asks a language model (the adversary) to guess a person's protected attribute. We introduce a prior-normalised clipped leakage score of its confidence gain on the true value and audit the conclusions drawn from it. Each verdict depends on an evaluation interface (the queried person, answer options, prior, adversary model and scoring rule), which we vary on fixed releases of three corpora. In a stress test, an editor that writes the opposite-sex form at the same spans a redaction editor would redact misleads the adversary about most people, yet ranks first among editors scored on the same MedQA entries under this score, as under attack accuracy and proper scoring rules read as privacy. A relabelling-invariant reading of AUC ranks that editor sixth of eight, and a rule-aware adversary recovers the attribute from the same text. On ordinary releases most verdict changes are gains or losses of separability; of six choices varied over all pairs, only the adversary reverses comparisons (5 of its 124 changes), and the query can target the wrong person. SACC, a traceable editor we build as the instrument, lets us ablate two editing principles and show where its advantage does not hold.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 剩余属性泄漏是一个接口:文本删除后的审计隐私评价
articles.content_zh: 对去识别文本的隐私评价要求语言模型(对手)猜测一个人受保护的属性. 我们提出一个事先正常的漏损分数,说明它对真实价值的信心增益,并审计从中得出的结论。 每个判决都取决于一个评价界面(被询问人,答案选项,前期,对手模式和评分规则),我们对于固定释放3个军团有不同的看法. 在压力测试中,一个编辑在同一时间跨度写出异性表的编辑会编辑误导对手对大多数人的误导,然而,在同一份MedQA条目上得分的编辑中排名第一,在攻击准确度和正确评分规则下读作隐私。 对AUC的重贴标签-invariant读数将编辑器排在八位中的第六位,一个规则意识的对手从同一个文本中恢复属性. 在普通发布时,大多数判决的改变是可分离性的增减;在所有对子中,有6个选择不同,只有对手反向比较(其124个变化中的5个),查询可以针对错误的人. SACC,一个可追踪的编辑器,我们作为仪器建造,让我们放弃两项编辑原则,并显示其优势所在。

articles.title: PROSE: Preservation-Constrained Selective Editing for Guilty Bias in Legal Judgment Prediction
articles.content: Legal judgment prediction models may retain a guilty verdict after a legally decisive condition has been altered such that the specified charge is no longer established. We study this guilty bias via selective repair over matched charge-established and charge-not-established cases, where the unsupported verdict should change while its supported counterpart remains stable. We construct CAIL-MC, a legally reviewed dataset of 11,478 matched pairs covering 261 Chinese criminal charges. Held-out activation interventions show that contrasts learned from correctly resolved pairs transfer to false-guilty cases, but target-reaching interventions can also damage matched supported-guilty decisions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce PROSE, which reconstructs case-specific targets from a training-derived residual geometry, aligns them with a local margin-descent signal, attenuates supported-guilty-sensitive components, and realizes bounded targets through a preservation-regularized low-rank parameter update. Across Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B, PROSE achieves stronger pairwise safe repair and evidence sensitivity, while preserving standard single-pass inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PROSE: 法律判决中有罪偏见的保存-限制选择性编辑
articles.content_zh: 法律判决预测模型在改变法律决定条件,规定的指控不再成立后,可以保留有罪判决。 我们通过有选择地修复已立案和未立案的对等案件来研究这种有罪偏见,在这些案件中,没有支持的判决应当改变,而得到支持的对等案件则保持稳定。 我们构建了CAIL-MC,一个经法律审查的11 478对匹配的数据集,涵盖261项中国刑事指控。 暂停激活干预表明,从正确解决的对子案件转移到虚假有罪案件中所学到的对比,但目标明确的干预也可能损害与支持的有罪决定相符。 基于这一观察,我们引入了PROSE,它从培训衍生的剩余几何学中重建了具体案例目标,使其与局部差值-差值信号一致,减弱了支持的有罪敏感成分,并通过保存-规范的低排名参数更新实现捆绑目标。 通过Quen3-8B和GLM4-9B,ProSE实现了更强的对偶安全修复和证据敏感性,同时保留了标准的单传推论.

articles.title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 写、 不只是点头: 图像检索视图语言模型中的头
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)可以在单一上下文中处理互页文本和多个图像,但它们如何在内部识别与一个问题相关的图像仍然不甚了解. 我们研究了这个定位步骤,作为内文本图像检索,并引入ICIR-MCQ,这是用于头级图像检索分析的控制探测器. 利用每个头的注意力质量 在图像托盘的跨度, 我们首先确定 稀疏的指针头 可靠地指向目标图像。 这些头转移到探针之外:一个单指头在自然主义多图像检索基准上与外部视觉语言检索器具有竞争能力,表明LVLMs含有强大的内部图像检索信号. 然而,仅仅注意就说明一个头的读法,而不是它的输出传递到后面的几层,所以我们引入了一个互补的产出侧分析. 对于每个头,我们训练一个轻量级图像检索器,记录其价值加权输出,并利用它来识别写作头,其输出包含足够的信息,可以识别目标图像. 令人惊讶的是,指针和写作标准选择了大不相同的头集,在每个标准下,前100个头组之间只有35到47个头部重叠. 定向设定分解显示,标准多图像推论中最重要的头集中在这个指针-写手交叉处,而只有一个标准选择的头则显示与随机头控件的分离不太一致. 最一致的因果效应来自基于注意力的指针和输出侧写法标准所选择的头. 代码和数据:https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-heads.

articles.title: TraceRouter++: Causal Semantic Routing Realignment via Optimal Transport
articles.content: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Trace Router++:通过优化运输方式进行因果语义循环调整
articles.content_zh: 大型基础模型(LFMs)尽管能力显著,但仍易受对抗性操纵。 目前的安全干预方法主要依赖于\textit{地点假说},刚性地压制孤立的神经元或特征. 然而,有害的语义表现为分布式的跨层电路,使局部化的沸腾既不利于复杂的越狱,也不利于一般用途。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议Texe Router++,即一个路由级安全干预框架,明确追踪在有害投入下启动的安全相关因果路径,并调整其不安全的激活状态。 我们的框架在\textit{Discover-Traces-Realign}范式中运作:它首先通过注意力差异确定一个敏感的触发层,并利用稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs)将密集的激活分解为可解释的路由特性。 随后,它通过特征影响分数(FIS)将这些特征映射到下游因果电路. 关键的是,从僵硬的抑制模式出发,Trace Router++引入了一种限制性的最佳运输(OT)软路线调整。 通过将安全干预制定为可引导的坐标-明智的边缘最佳运输近似,我们的方法将不安全的激活边缘转向因果识别的路由子空间的安全参考边缘,同时在干预点保留非选定的坐标。 这种机制安全地引导恶意语义流,同时使正交计算路线完好无损. 跨越具有代表性的大型语言模型(LLMs)、多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)和传播模型(DMs)的广泛实验表明,TraceRouter++的绩效超过了对基线的评价,提高了对抗力,同时保持了有利的安全-效用权衡。 警告:本文包含不安全的模型响应.

articles.title: One Assistant, Many Memories: Benchmarking Real-World Group Assistance When Recall Is Not Enough
articles.content: The value of memory lies not only in recall but in using it to provide appropriate assistance. Recent benchmarks test memory use in personalisation and agentic tasks, but seldom evaluate assistance without fixed answers or integration across multiple participants. Group chats make both challenges more acute: an assistant must integrate information from multiple members, track revisions and conflicts over time, and produce one response for the group. Yet existing group memory benchmarks rely on synthetic conversations and inherit constrained evaluation from general memory benchmarks, focusing on recall against fixed answers or decisions over a closed set. We introduce GroupAssistBench, the first memory benchmark from real-world group conversations with a deployed group assistant, covering 80,299 messages in 50 groups and costing over $53K. Over the same histories, GroupAssistBench evaluates memory recall (L1) with reference answers and memory use (L2) with service requests without fixed answers across single, distributed, and conflicting memories (M1--M3). Requests are verified to require group history, memories are anchored to their sources, and L2 uses tailored rubrics with penalties derived from real user feedback. Across evaluations of frontier models with full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems, the strongest memory system rivals full context on recall but falls far behind on use, especially for distributed and conflicting memories. Together, two additions that relate retrieved memories and bind remembered facts as response constraints bring consistent gains, showing that group memory systems must improve use, not recall alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 1名助理,《许多回忆:回顾不足时,确定现实世界团体援助的基准》
articles.content_zh: 记忆的价值不仅在于记忆,还在于利用记忆提供适当援助。 最近的基准测试了个人化和代理任务中的内存使用,但很少在没有固定答案或多个参与者的整合的情况下评价援助. 分组聊天使得这两个挑战更加尖锐:一个助手必须整合来自多个成员的信息,跟踪一段时间内的修订和冲突,并为小组生成一个响应. 然而,现有的群体内存基准依赖于合成对话,并继承了一般内存基准中受限制的评价,侧重于对照固定答案或对一个封闭的一组决定进行召回. 我们介绍GroupAssist Bench,这是现实世界小组与部署的小组助理对话的第一个内存基准,涵盖50个小组的80 299条信息,费用超过53K美元。 在同一段历史中,GroupAsist Bench用参考答案和内存使用(L2)来评价内存召回(L1),服务请求没有固定答案,跨越单个,分布,相互冲突的记忆(M1-M3). 请求被核实为需要群体历史,记忆被固定在源头上,L2使用特制标题,从真实的用户反馈中得出处罚. 在对具有完整背景的前沿模型、检索方法和记忆系统的评价中,最强的记忆系统在召回方面与完整背景相对应,但远远落后于使用,特别是在分布式记忆和相互冲突的记忆方面。 由于反应限制,两个与被检索的记忆相关联的添加和将记忆中的事实捆绑在一起,共同带来持续收益,表明群体记忆系统必须改进使用,而不只是召回.

articles.title: Feeling of Knowing in Large Language Models
articles.content: Post-training updates change what large language models (LLMs) can answer, but may leave their answerability judgments misaligned. We study this knowledge-judgment desynchronization through functional feeling of knowing (FoK), which supports selective generation, retrieval triggering, and model routing without implying subjective experience. We propose two trainable channels: a knowledge channel that changes answerability and a FoK channel that judges the current knowledge state. Three stages train them: on-policy supervised fine-tuning (OP-SFT) updates knowledge from corrected on-policy answers; knowledge-delta FoK training (K$Δ$-FT) adapts judgments across intermediate knowledge states; and FoK-guided policy optimization (FGPO) trains the subsequent answer or explanation. Factual-QA experiments, cross-dataset evaluation, and three sequential updates show that explicit FoK alignment improves judgment quality on updated knowledge. MMLU and ARC-Easy separately assess capability preservation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在大语言模型中的知觉
articles.content_zh: 训练后更新会改变大语言模型(LLMs)能够回答的问题,但可能会让其应答判断错位. 我们通过知的功能感(FoK)来研究这种知识判断去同步性,它支持选择性生成,检索触发,以及模型的路由,但不暗示主观的经验. 我们提出两个可训练的渠道:改变可回答性的知识渠道和判断当前知识状态的FoK通道。 三个阶段对他们进行培训:政策监督微调(OP-SFT)从纠正的政策答案中更新知识;知识-delta FoK培训(K$Δ$-FT)在中间知识国家中调整判断;以及FoK指导政策优化(FGPO)培训后续答案或解释. 事实-QA实验,跨数据集评价,以及三个相继更新显示,明确的Fok对齐提高了对最新知识的判断质量. MMLU和ARC-Easy分别评估能力保护.

articles.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
articles.content: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

articles.title: Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery (Extended Version)
articles.content: LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated. We study truth discovery among such agents: inferring the true answer and each agent's reliability without labels. Classical truth-discovery and crowdsourcing estimators reward an agreeing bloc and can fall below majority vote. We propose BP-TD, which adds per-agent decorrelation weights to mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model, so that agents sharing a base model count together as about one vote. Its first iteration is exactly a weighted vote; later iterations estimate agent reliability. With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert. The gain depends on the pool: over 2,852 sub-pools of four benchmarks, decorrelation helps when the largest correlated bloc is weaker than the other agents and hurts when it is the strongest, and we found no label-free statistic that tells the two cases apart. Labels change the picture quickly: with 20 labelled questions, selecting the single best agent is more accurate than every aggregator we tested on MMLU, ARC and TruthfulQA.

articles.title: ReSI-Math: Exploring Recoverable Capability Frontiers for Efficient Reasoning Improvement
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, a fundamental question remains: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability? In this work, we reveal that direct failure does not necessarily imply inability. Some reasoning failures can be recovered by exploring the model's own trajectories, exposing a recoverable capability frontier: a policy-dependent region where solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through trajectory-level search. Based on this observation, we introduce ReSI-Math, a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and converts recovered capabilities into data-efficient RLVR supervision. ReSI-Math uses Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search to identify recoverable failures under a fixed policy and adaptively selects frontier problems for sequential RLVR as the policy evolves. On Qwen3-VL-8B, correct-incorrect trajectory crossover produces 272 verifier-confirmed correct offspring from 621 attempts (43.8%). After three sequential one-shot RLVR stages, the MATH500 and WE-MATH average improves from 78.71 to 80.16. Under matched single-problem RLVR, random selection reaches only 53.31 versus 54.16 for frontier-guided Q1.

articles.title_zh: ReSI-Math:探索可回收能力前沿以高效合理改进
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为改进大语言模型的数学推理的有效方法. 然而,一个根本问题仍然存在:当一个模式未能解决问题时,它是否真的缺乏根本能力? 在这项工作中,我们揭示,直接失败并不一定意味着不能。 一些推理失败可以通过探索模型本身的轨迹来恢复,暴露出一个可回收的能力前沿:一个依赖政策的区域,通过直接解码无法可靠地生成解决方案,但可以通过轨迹级搜索获得解决方案. 基于这一观察,我们引入了ReSI-Math,这是一个探索可回收能力前沿并将回收能力转化为数据高效的RLVR监督的框架. ReSI-Math采用自律师指导的进化搜索,以识别固定政策下可收回的失败,并随政策的发展而适应性地选择前沿问题,用于顺序的RLVR. 在Qune3-VL-8B上,正确不正确的轨迹交叉产生来自621次尝试(43.8%)的272个验证器确认正确的后代. 经过三个相继的一发RLVR级,MATH500和WE-MATH的平均值从78.71提高到80.16. 在匹配的单问题RLVR下,随机选择只达到53.31,而边框制导的Q1则达到54.16.
